Mishneh Torah, Vessels 7: Kele or meematay mekabbelin tuma. hatturemal vechayyotze bo mishsheyyachsom siftotav veyichrot hakkofin hakketannim hayyotzin al gabbe haor veyaase kichotav. sekuretiya mishsheyyachsom veyichrot veyaase tzitzatah. katavuleya mishsheyyachsom veyichrot. hakkar vehakkeset shel or mishsheyyachsom siftotehen veyichrot hakkofin hayyotzin. vechen kol kayyotze bahen. hattefillin mishsheyyigmor hakketzitza af al pi shehu atid latet bah et hartzua mekabbelet tuma. or haarisa shehu atid laasot lo tabbur ad sheyyaasennu lo. hassandal mishsheyyakmia. hamminal misheyyiggov [al] haimmum. veim atid locharkem ulesartet ad sheyyicharkem visartet:

Or sheen alav tzurat keli eno mekabbel tuma. lefichach kaf shel or shekkoshrin lokte kotzim al kappotehen kede shello yakkem kotz eno mekabbel tuma mippene shehu or pashut veen alav tzurat keli. vechen haor shemmelakketin bo gelale habbakar veor shechosmin bo pi habbehema veor shemmoshivin bo haddevorim beshaa shellokchin haddevash veor shemmenifin bo et haruach mippene hachom tehorin veen mekabbelin tuma:
Kol bet haetzbaot shel or tehorot chutz mishshel kayaytzin mippene shehi mekabbelet et haog temea. nikrea im enah mekabbelet et rov haog tehora:

Haavnet shel orot veorot shettofrin hakkitteim al arkubbotehen kede sheyyitgalgelu bahen al hakkarka mekabbelin tuma shehare tzurat keli alehen. vechen haorot haasuyot keen tabbaot shemmachnisin otan haummanin bizrootehen kede lehagebiah bigdehen mealehen bishat melacha mittammein kishar kele or happeshutim:

Or shettofrin mimmennu kissuy leyad velizroa shel zore ginnot veshel holche derachim veshel ose pishtan mekabbelin tuma. veim haya shel tzabbaim veshel nappachim eno mekabbel tuma. ze hakkelal kol heasuy lekabbala kede shello yakkehu kotz uchede sheyyochaz yafe yafe mekabbel tuma. veheasuy mippene hazzea kede shello yippased haddavar shemmitassek bo bezeat yado eno mekabbel tuma:

Kamma shiur hannekev sheyyinnakev keli haor veyithar. hachemet mishshettinnakev kemotzi pekaiyyot shel sheti. veim enah yechola lekabbel shel sheti hoil umekabbelet shel erev mekabbelet tuma ad shettinnakev rubbah:
Hatturmil shennifchat hakkis shebbetocho adayin hatturmil mekabbel tuma veeno chibbur lo:
Hachemet shehabbetzim shellah mekabbelot immah venifchatu tehorot sheenan mekabbelot kedarkan:

Keli or sheyyesh lo lulaot ushenatzot kegon sandal imki vechis shel shenatzot af al pi shekkeshehen muttarin en alehen tzurat keli hare ellu mekabbelin tuma keshehen muttarin hoil vehahedyot yachol bimhera lehachenis hashshenatzot ballulaot veyachzor keli kibbul keshehaya. vechen im nitmeu vehesir hashshenatzot mehen venifseda tzuratan hare hen tehorin af al pi sheefshar lehacheziran shello beumman:

Kis shel shenatzot shennittelu shenatzav adayin hu mekabbel tuma shehare hu mekabbel. nifshat vechazar or pashut tahor. tala alav et hammatlet millematta mekabbelet tuma af al pi shehu pashut shehare yesh alav tzurat keli:

Or shekkarach bo et hakkamea mekabbel tuma. peshato tahor. chazar vecharach bo mekabbel tuma. mittamme umittaher afillu eser peamim beyom. veor shekkatav alav et hakkamea tahor. veim karat mimmennu veasa chulya letachshit mekabbel tuma:

Hattefilla shel rosh arbaa kelim hi. hare shennitmet bemet vehittir ketzitza harishona vetikkenah hare hi av tuma keshehayta. vechen im hittir hashsheniyya vetikkenah. veim hittir af hashshelishit vetikkenah vehittir af harviit vetikkenah naaset kullah rishon letuma. shehare hittir kol achat veachat vechazar vetikkenam kullam ucheillu zo tefillin acharonot shennagu barishonot. chazar vehittir et harishona paam sheniyya vetikkenah hare hi rishon keshehayta. vechen im hittir et hashsheniyya veet hashshelishit. chazar vehittir af harviit vetikkenah hare kullah tehora sheen harishon metamme kelim mippene shehu valad kemo shebbearnu. vechen sandal shehu teme midras venifseka achat meaznav vetikkenah tame midras. nifseka sheniyya vetikkenah hare hu tahor min hammidras shehare naasu lo aznayim chadashot aval teme magga midras. lo hispik letakken et harishona ad shennifseka hashsheniyya o shennifsak akevo o nittal chatmo o nechlak lishnayim tahor:
Minal shennifchat im eno mekabbel rov haregel tahor:
Tefilla shennitmet meematay tohoratah. shel yad mishsheyyattir otah mishshalosh ruchot. veshel rosh mishsheyyattir mishshalosh ruchot uven ketzitza lachavertah:

Hakkaddur vehaimmum vehakkame vehattefillin shennikreu achar shennitmeu hannogea bahen tame uvema shebbetochan tahor. haikkuf shennikra hannogea bema shebbetocho tame mippene shehattefer mechabbero venaasa kullo keguf echad:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 8:
Kol kele mattachot enan mekabbelin tuma ad shettiggamer melachtan kullah velo yihye hakkeli mechussar maase kelal. aval galme kele mattachot enan mekabbelin tuma: 
Veellu hen galme kele mattachot kol sheatid lashuf oto o leshabbetz o ligror o lecharkev o lehakkish bekurnas. o shehaya mechussar ozen o ogen. hare ze eno mekabbel tuma ad sheyyetakkenennu viyappehu velo tishshaer bo melacha kelal. ketzad. hassayif eno mekabbel tuma ad sheyyeshufennu. vehassakkin ad sheyyashchizenna. vechen kol kayyotze bemaasim ellu. lefichach haose kelim min haeshet shel barzel o min hacharara shel mattechet umin hassovev shel galgal umin hattassin umin hatztzippuyin umikkanne hakkelim umeogne hakkelim umeazne hakkelim umin hashshechula umin haggerodet hare ellu tehorim mippene shekkol ellu shennaasu galme kele mattachot hen. aval haose keli mishshivre kele mattachot umin hakkelim shennishchaku merov hazzeman umin hammasmerot sheyyadua shennaasu min hakkelim hare ellu mekabbelin tuma lefi sheenam golamim. aval masmerot sheen yadua im naasu min hakkelim o min haeshet hare hen tehorin afillu hitkin otam lichli enam mekabbelin tuma: 
Keli mattachot sheeno mechussar ella kissuy mekabbel tuma sheen hakkissuy chashuv migguf hakkeli: 
Machat shello nikkevah ella shafah vetikkenah lechach mittechillatah mekabbelet tuma mippene shemmotziin bah et hakkotz. aval im atid lenakkevah hare hi kishar galme kele mattachot veenah mekabbelet tuma: 
Meachar shebbearnu sheggalme kele mattachot tehorim vegalme kele etz temeim. ufeshute kele mattachot temeim ufeshute kele etz tehorim din tora. nimtza hattame bichle etz tahor bichle mattachot tame bichle mattachot tahor bichle etz: 
Kol kele hammilchama kegon hassayif veharomach vehakkova vehashshiryon vehammaggafayim vechayyotze bahen mekabbelin tuma. vechol tachshite haadam kegon hakkatala vehannezamim vehattabbaot ben sheyyesh alehen chotam ben sheen alehem chotam vechayyotze bahen mekabbelin tuma. afillu dinar shennifsal vehitkino litloto betzavvar ketanna mekabbel tuma. vechen kamea shel mattechet mittamme kechol tachshit adam: 
Kol tachshite habbehema vehakkelim kegon hattabbaot sheosin letzavvar habbehema uleazne hakkelim tehorin veenan mekabbelin tuma bifne atzman. chutz mizzog shel behema vechelim hammashmia kol laadam. ketzad. haose zogin lemachteshet velaarisa lemitpechot sefarim vetinokot tehorim. asa lahen inbolin mekabbelim tuma hoil venaasu lehashemia kol laadam hare hen ketachshite adam. vaafillu nittelu inbolehen mekabbelin tuma shehare hu rauy lehakkisho al hacheres: 
Zog heasuy leadam. im naasa lekatan eno mekabbel tuma ella bainbol shello shehare lekol naasa. naasa legadol hare ze tachshit umekabbel tuma af al pi sheen lo inbol: 
Kol happartzufot mekabbelot tuma. vechol hachotamot tehorin. chutz mechotam shel mattechet shebbo chotmin bilvad. vechol hattabbaot tehorot chutz mittabbaat etzba. aval tabbaat shechoger bo et matnav shekkoshrah ben ketefav tehora. tabbaat hashsher shel behema hoil vehaadam moshech bah et habbehema mekabbelet tuma. vechen makkel shel behema shel mattechet hoil veadam rode otah bo mekabbelet tuma: 
Kol hakkelim yordim letuma bemachshava veen olin mide tuma ella beshinnuy maase. vehammaase mevattel miyyad hammaase umiyyad hammachshava. vehammachshava enah mevattelet lo miyyad hammaase velo miyyad hammachshava. ketzad. tabbaat behema o kelim shechashav aleha lehachezirah tabbaat adam hare zo mekabbelet tuma bemachshava zo ucheillu naaset leadam mittechillat asiyyatah. chazar vechishshev aleha lehannichah tabbaat behema keshehaya af al pi shello nitkashshet bah haadam hare zo mekabbelet tuma sheen hammachshava mevattelet miyyad hammachshava ad sheyyaase maase bagguf kegon sheyyashuf otah o yitkaah bemaase shel behema. hayta hattabbaat laadam vechishshev aleha livhema adayin hi mekabbelet tuma keshehayta sheen hakkelim olin mide tumatan bemachshava. asa bah maase veshinna livhema enah mekabbelet tuma shehammaase mevattel miyyad hammaase: 
Cheresh shote vekatan yesh lahen maase veen lahen machashava kemo shebbearnu lemala beinyan hechsher ochalin: 
Zog shel delet shechishshev aleha livhema mekabbel tuma. veshel behema sheasauhu laddelet afillu chibbero bakkarka vaafillu kevao bemasmer mekabbel tuma keshehaya ad sheyyeshanne bo maase begufo: 
Umman sheose umanniach zogin livhema velidlatot im rov heasuy ledavar shemmekabbel tuma hare hakkol mekabbel tuma ad sheyyafrish miktzatan ledavar sheeno mekabbel tuma. veim rov heasuy ledavar sheen mekabbel tuma hare hakkol tahor ad sheyyafrish miktzatan ledavar hamekabbel tuma: 
Zogin hannimtzain bechol makom mekabbelin tuma chutz mehannimtzaim bakkerakkim mippene sherubban lidlatot: 
Amar leumman ase li shene zogim echad ledelet veechad livhema. ase li shete machtzelaot achat lishchiva veachat leohalim. ase li shene sedinim echad letzurot veechad leohalim. shenehen mekabbelin tuma ad sheyyefaresh veyomar ze lechach veze lechach:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 9:
Kol kele mattachot sheyyesh lahen shem bifne atzman mekabbelin tuma chutz min haddelet vehanneger vehammanul vehappotat shettachat hatztzir vehatztzir vehakkora vehatztzinnor mippene sheellu asuyin lekarka o leshammesh et haetz enan mekabbelin tuma vaafillu kodem sheyyikkavu. vechol keli mattachot sheyyesh lo shem levavy eno mittamme bifne atzmo mippene shehu kemiktzat keli. ketzad. akrav shel perumebya tame ulechayayim shellah sheal lechaye habbehema mikkan umikkan tehorin. veen mekabbelin tuma bifne atzman mippene sheen lahem shem bifne atzman. uvishat chibburan hakkol mekabbel tuma: 
Tassin shel barzel shemmannichin al lechaye haadam bishat milchama enan mekabbelin tuma mippene sheen lahem shem bifne atzman. veim yesh bahen bet kibbul mayim mittammein kechol keli kibbul: 
Nezem heasuy kikdera millematta vechaadasha millemala venifsak hakkedera shello mekabbelet tuma bifne atzmah shehare yesh lah bet kibbul vehaadasha mekabbelet tuma bifne atzmah mippene sheyyesh lah shem bifne atzmah. vehatztzenira shellah shehi nichneset baozen o baaf enah mekabbelet tuma bifne atzmah. haya hannezem asuy kemin eshkol venifrak tahor mippene sheen bo bet kibbul veen lechol gargir mimmennu shem bifne atzmo vahare eno rauy letachshit mishshennifrak: 
Tabbaat achat shemmannichin habbanot beregel achat hi hannikret birit veenah mekabbelet tuma mippene sheen aleha tzurat keli tachshit ella kemo tabbaat hakkelim o tabbaat shekkosher bah ben ketefav. aval shete tabbaot shemmesimot habbanot beraglehen veshalshelet muttelet benehen mizzo lezo mekabbelin tuma mippene shehen tachshite habbanot vehen hannikrain kevalim: 
Katla shel chulyot shel mattechet vehem bechut shel tzemer o shel pishtan venifsak hachut. hachulyot mekabbelot tuma shekkol echad veechad keli bifne atzmo. haya hachut shellah shel mattechet vehachulyot shel avanim tovot veshel margaliyyot o shel zechuchit venishberu hachulyot vehachut kayyam hare ze mittamme bifne atzmo. sheyare katla kimlo tzavvar ketanna: 
Kol hakkissuyin shel mattechet tehorin veen mekabbelin tuma mippene sheen lahem shem bifne atzman. chutz mikkissuy hammecham umikkissuy teni shel rofin mippene shemmannichin bo et haispelanit naase keli kibbul: 
Kissuy shel mattechet sheshshafo velittesho veasahu mara hare ze mekabbel tuma: 
Kol hammishkolot shel mattachot mekabbelot tuma vehen hannikrain onkiot. kene moznayim shel etz shehayu onkiyyot shel barzel teluyot bo mekabbelet tuma mippene haonkiyyot hatteluyot bo. bamme devarim amurim bemoznayim shel mochre pishtan umochre tzemer. aval shel baale battim eno mekabbel tuma ad sheyyihyu haonkiyyot kevuot bo: 
Mishkalot shennishtabberu af al pi shehechziran veshokel bahen enan mekabbelin tuma. yiched mehen chatzae litrin shelishe litrin revie litrin hare ellu mekabbelin tuma: 
Sela shennifsela vehitkinah lihyot shokel bah mekabbelet tuma: 
Unkeli shel kattafim tehora veshel rochlim mittammea. unkeli shel naklite hammitta tehora veshel dargish mittammea. unkeli shel kavveret hatztzayyadim shetztzadin bahen haddagim tahor veshel shidda mittammea. unkeli shel menorot haetz tahor veshel shulchan mittammea. ze hakkelal kol keli shemmekabbel tuma bifne atzmo min hattora hare haunkeli shel mattechet shello veshalshelet shello mekabbelet tuma. ucheli sheeno mekabbel tuma kegon peshute kele etz uchele etz habbaim bemidda vechayyotze bahen unkeli shel mattechet vehashshalshelet shello enan mekabbelin tuma vechol achat veachat bifne atzmah tehora sheen haunkeli o hashshalshelet keli bifne atzmo ella hare hen kemiktzat keli. vaafillu unkeli shebbakketalim shettolin bah hakkelim vehabbegadim vechayyotze bahen tehora: 
Shalshelet sheyyesh bah bet neila mittammea vehaasuya lichfita tehora: 
Shalshelet shel sitonot mittammea mippene shehen noalin bah et hachanuyyot. veshel baale battim tehora sheenah asuya ella lenoy: 
Shalshelet shel moshche karka vitedotehen shettokin bakkarka beshaa shemmoshchin mekabbelin tuma. veshel mekoshshe etzim tehora lefi shehi meshammeshet et haetz: 
Shalshelet deli gadol arbaa tefachim mimmenna samuch laddeli mittammea im haddeli mippene shehi tzorech haddeli vehashshear tahor lefi sheen lo shem bifne atzmo. veshalshelet deli katan asara tefachim: 
Hakkaddur shel mattechet vehassaddan. vehakkantar shel bannay. vehaddakkar shel charash. vachamor shel nappach. vehametulttelet. vehammishkolot shel bannaim. vehakkirayim shel barzel shechovtin bahem hazzetim. vehaafarkes shel mattechet. vehaolar shekkortin bo hassofrim rosh hakkulmos shel kane. vehakkulmos shel mattechet. vehakkan. vehakkana shemmesartetin bo hassofrim. kol ellu mekabbelin tuma shekkol echad mehen yesh lo shem bifne atzmo:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 10:
Masmerot shemmachazikin bahen hattikra haasuyin litkoa oto beetzim enan mekabbelin tuma. vechen hammasmerot shettokin otan bakketalim litlot bahen. veim hitkino lihyot keli bifne atzmo mekabbel tuma. ketzad. masmer shehitkino lihyot poteach venoel bah o lehotzi et happetila o shennetano berechayim shel yad o shel chamor hare ze mekabbel tuma. hitkino liftoach bo et hechavit tahor ad sheyyitzrefennu: 
Masmer heasuy kesiman lishmirat happetach eno mekabbel tuma. vechen masmer shel shulchani shettole bo hammoznayim vehakkis tahor. vechen teloye hammigradot tehorot. af al pi shemmasmerin ellu meshunnin betzuratan mishshear masmerot hattekia: 
Masmer haggara vehu hakkeli shemmakkizin mekabbel tuma. umasmer shel even hashshaot tahor: 
Masmer haggardi vehu hammasmer haaroch keen shippud shemmachnis bo haoreg shefoferet hakkane o haetz velofef aleha chutim mekabbel tuma: 
Ellu kele mattachot hammittammeot baagala. haol shel mattechet. vehakkatrav. vehakkenafayim hamekabbelot et hartzuot. uvarzel shettachat tzavvere habbehema. vehassomech. vehammachger. vehattamchuyyot. vehainbol. vehatztzenira. umasmer hamechabber et kullam. veellu tehorim baagala. haol shel etz hametzuppe. uchenafayim haasuyin lenoy. vehashshefofarot hammashmiot et hakkol. vehaavar shebbetzad tzavvere behema. vehassovev shel galgal. vehattassin vehatztzippuyin. ushear kol hammasmerot shebbah tehorin: 
Akrav bet habbad mekabbel tuma. aron shel garosot af al pi shehu tahor im hayta tachtav agala shel mattechet hare zo mekabbelet tuma: 
Rechayim shel pilpelin mekabbelet tuma mishshum shelosha kelim mishshum keli mattachot umishshum keli kibbul umishshum kevara: 
Haddelet shel mattechet shebbemigdal shel baale battim enah mekabbelet tuma. veshel rofim mekabbelet tuma mippene shemmannichim bah et haispelanit vetole bah et hammisparayim: 
Tassin shel mattechet shemmenaarin bahen et hakkedera mekabbelin tuma. vehakkevuin bakkira tehorin: 
Hammelkachayim shemmemaech bahen et happetila mekabbelin tuma. vehatztzinnorot shettofsot et harechayim millemala enan mekabbelot tuma. mippene sheenan asuyot ella lechazzek: 
Kelostera shennoalin bah haddelatot im hayta shel mattechet mittammea. hayta shel etz umetzuppa mattechet tahor: 
Happin vehappurena temeim: 
Pika shel mattechet tehora lefi shehi meshammeshet et haetz: 
Hakkush vehappima vehammakkel vesimponya vechalil shel mattechet mekabbelin tuma. hayu shel etz umetzuppin mattechet tahor. chutz min hassimponya sheim haya bah bet kibbul kenafayim af al pi shehi metzuppa temea: 
Hachatzotzeret shemmefutztzelet chulyot chulyot. im en yodea lehachezirah ella umman hare zo mekabbelet tuma keshehi mechubberet. veim yecholin hakkol lefarkah ulehachazirah enah mekabbelet tuma: 
Hakkatze shemmannichin happe alav bishat tekia mekabbel tuma bifne atzmo. vehakkatze haacher harachav eno mekabbel tuma bifne atzmo. uvishat chibbur hakkol tame. kayyotze bo kene menora bifne atzman enan mekabbelin tuma mippene sheyyesh lahen shem levavy. happerach shellah vehabbasis mittammein bifne atzman uvishat chibbur hakkol tame: 
Korat hachitztzim shehi hammattara sheyyesh bah leshonot shel mattechet mekabbelet tuma. veshemmannichim otah beragle haasurim tehora. vehakkolar mekabbel tuma. megera sheasa shinneha lechor haddelet af al pi shemmishtammesh bah enah mekabbelet tuma. veim mishshennitmet asaah lechor haddelet hare zo betumatah ad sheyyikbaenna bemasmer. hafachah ben millemala ben millematta ben min hatztzedadim tehora:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 11: Kamma shiur hashshever sheyyishshaver keli mattechet velo yekabbel tuma o yithar mittumato. hakkol lefi ma shehu:

Kol zeman shehakkeli yachol laasot meen melachto adayin hu keli vechashuv keli shalem. ketzad. keli shel mattechet shennishbar vahare hu yachol lemalleot bo hare hu keli keshehaya. hakkumkum kede lachom bo chammin. hammecham kede lekabbel selaim. hallefas kede lekabbel kitonot shel mattechet. hakkiton kede lekabbel perutot. middot hayyayin kede lamod bahen hayyayin. vechen middot hashshemen kede lamod bahen hashshemen. mesannenet shel chardal shennifretzu bah shelosha nekavim millematta ze letoch ze tehora lefi sheenah meshammeshet meen melachtah. magrefa shennittela kappah af al pi shehi kekurnas tehora sheenah osa meen melachtah ella meen hakkurnas. vehi lo naaset litkoa bah kekurnas. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Masrek shel tzemer shennittelu shinnav im nishtayyer bo shelosha bemakom echad tame. hayta hachitzona achat min hashshelosha tahor lefi sheeno yachol lisrok bo pishtan shehachitzona enah moelet lisrok vechol sheeno ose meen melachto bichli mattechet tahor. nittelu min hammasrek shetayim vaasaan limlakketet temeot. achat vehitkinah lener o lilpof aleha hachut lerikkum mekabbelet tuma. veim hayta hashshen ava ugedola af al pi shello hitkinah hare zo mittammet bifne atzmah:
Masrek shel pishtan shennittelu shinnav venishtayyer bo shetayim tame. nishtayyer bo achat tahor:
Hakkerumim shennishberu veunkeli shellahen kayyemet temein shehare efshar lehotzi bahen haddeli min habbeer keshehayu mikkodem:
Megera shennittela shen achat mibbentayim tehora. nishtayyer bah melo hassit bemakom echad temea shehare efshar lagor bannishar:

Hammaatzad vehaizmel vehammafselet vehammakdeach shennifgemu adayin mekabbelin tuma. nittal chissuman tehorin. vechullan shennechleku lishnayim temein chutz min hammakdeach shehare eno yachol linkov bo. veharuneki bifne atzmah enah mekabbelet tuma mippene shehi miktzat keli:

Hassayif vehassakkin vehassakkin heakom kemo maggal veharomach umaggal yad umaggal katzir vezug misparayim ketannim shel baale battim vezug misparayim gedolim shel sapparim shennechleku kol chelek mehen mekabbel tuma mippene shehu ose meen melachto:
Misparayim shennechleka lishnayim tehora lefi sheenah maaveret et hassear ella bedochak:

Shiryon shennechlak learko tahor. lerachbo im meshammesh meen melachto rishona tame. meematay tohorato mishsheyyivle veeno meshammesh meen melachto. bala venishtayyer bo rubbo im millemala tame veim millematta tahor. kitztzetz mimmennu veasa chulya letachshit hare zo mekabbelet tuma:
Shefoferet shel zehavim veshel zogin veshel nappachim veshel ose zechuchit shennechleka learkah tehora. lerachbah im meshammeshet meen melachtah rishona temea veim lav tehora:
Kalviya shel sapparim veshel rofim veshel ose zechuchit shennechleka lishnayim tehora. veshel nappachim temea mippene shehu battechilla [chote bah et haggechalim] veachshav chote bah et haggechalim:
Mara shel mattechet shennishbera o shennittashtesha im enah mara rov happanim tehora. hayta mara rov happanim adayin hi keli keshehayta:

Machat shennittal ketzatah hannakuv o ektzah tehora. veim hitkinah lilpof aleha hachut lirkom bah temea. aval machat shel sakkin shennittal ketzatah hannakuv temea mippene shehu roshem bakkatze hashsheni:
Hammachat shelloffin aleha hashshani o hazzahav vechayyotze bahen kederech sheosin harokmin ben shennittal hannakuv shellah ben shennittal ektzah temea sheen melachtah hattefira:
Machat sheheelta chaluda im meakkevet hattefira tehora veim lav temea:
Hassayif vehassakkin sheheelu chaluda tehorin. shefaan vehishchizan chazru letumatan hayeshana. vechen tzinora sheppeshatah tehora. kefafah chazra letumatah hayeshana:

Mafteach akom kemo arkubba shennishbar mittoch arkubbotav tahor. vechen mafteach heasuy kemin gam shennishbar mittoch gammo tahor shehare eno yachol liftoach bahen vahare enan meshammeshin meen melachtan. hayu bah shinnayim unekavim tame sheadayin hu mafteach. nittelu hashshinnayim tame mippene hannekavim. nistemu hannekavim tame mippene hashshinnayim. nittelu hashshinnayim venistemu hannekavim o shennifretzu hannekavim ze letoch ze tahor:

Keli sheyyesh berosho haechad kaf leharim bo haddeshen uverosho hashsheni mazleg litzlot bo habbasar nittela kappo tame mippene shinnav nittelu shinnav tame mippene kappo. vechen michchol shennittela kappo sheggorfin bah hakkechol tame mippene hazzachar shekkochalim bo haayin nittal hazzachar tame mippene hakkaf:

Keli shebberosho kaf echad kisvacha litzlot alav uvakkatze hashsheni shinnayim lehotzi mehen habbasar min hakkedera o meal haesh nittela kappo tame mippene shinnav nittelu shinnav tame mippene kappo. vechen et shel mattechet shekkotvin berosho haechad uverosho hashsheni mochakin nittal hakkotev tame mippene hammochek nittal hammochek tame mippene hakkotev. vechen kayyotze beellu. vehu sheyyihye hannishar yachol laasot meen melachtan. ketzad. et shennittal hammochek shello venishar hakkotev im nishar mearko kede sheyyaga lekishre etzbeotav tame shehare efshar sheyyochaz bo veyichtov bo. nittal hakkotev venishar hammochek im nishar mearko melo pas yado tame shehare efshar lo limchok bo. nishar pachot mizze tahor. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Kordom shennittal eshpo vehu hatztzad shehecharash menagger bo tame mippene bet bikkuo. nittal bet bikkuo tame mippene bet ushpo. nishbar makkifo tahor:
Charchur shennifgam adayin hu keli ad sheyyinnatel rubbo. nishbar makkifo tahor:

Hammardea hu hammalmad vehu etz aroch av uchemo masmer chad takua biktzato millemala veze habbarzel nikra darvan uvakkatze hashsheni millematta mimmennu barzel kemo romach vehaetz nichnas veze habbarzel nikra charchur:

Menikat shel mattechet shehi kemo shefoferet shennitmea mishsheyyikbaenna bammakkel o baddelet vichabberenna im haetz tithar. lo nitmea ukevaah bammakkel o baddelet hare zo mekabbelet tuma bimkomah shekkol kele mattachot shekkevaam bekora o bakkotel mekabbelin tuma keshehayu ad sheyyeshanne et maasehem. lefichach daf shel nachtomin shel mattechet shekkevao bakkotel tame. vechen kol kayyotze baze mishshear kele mattachot shennikbeu ben mekabbelehen ben peshutehen mekabbelim tuma keshehayu:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 12:
Kele etz uchele or uchele etzem shennishberu tiharu mittumatan. chazar veasa keli mishshivrehem o shekkibbetz et shivrehen veasa mehen kelim acherim hare ellu kishar hakkelim hattehorim shello nitmeu mikkodem shehen mekabbelin tuma mikkan ulehabba. vechen kele mattachot shennishberu achar shennitmeu tiharu. hittichan vechazar veasa mehen kelim acherim chazru lattuma hayeshana. veen lichle mattachot tohora gemura ad sheyyatbilem bemikve keshehem shelemim o yishshaaru shevurim: 
Vachazarat kele mattachot letumatan hayeshana middivre sofrim umippene ma gazru al kele mattachot sheyyachzeru letumatan hayeshana gezera shemma yetamme lo keli veyattichennu veyaase mimmennu keli acher bo beyom im yomar shehu tahor kedin tora yavo lomar hashshevira metaheret vehattevila metaheret keshem sheim nishbar vehitticho veasa mimmennu keli keshehaya hare hu tahor bo bayyom kach im hitbilo af al pi shehu keshehaya hare hu tahor bo bayyom veyavou lomar sheen hakkelim tzerichin haarev shemesh mippene ze hachashash gazru tuma alehem: 
Echad keli shennitma bemet o bishar hattumot im hitticho chazar letumato hayeshana ad sheyyatbil. nitma bemet vehizza alav bashshelishi veachar kach hitticho vaasaahu keli acher vehizza alav bashshevii vehitbilo hare ze tame veen hazzaya shekkodem hittuch mitztarefet lehazzaa sheachar hittuch veen lo tohora ad sheyyazze alav shelishi ushevii veyatbil keshehu keli kodem shevira o yazze alav shelishi ushevii veyatbil achar sheyyattichennu: 
Barzel tame shebbelalo im barzel tahor im rov min hattame tame veim rov min hattahor tahor. mechetza lemechetza tame. vechen tit shebbelalo biglalim vesaraf hakkol bechivshan vaasaahu keli im rov min hattit hare ze mekabbel tuma mippene shehu keli cheres veim rov min haggelalim eno mekabbel tuma: 
Kele mattachot hattehorin sheanachan baanach tame temeim. aval haose kelim min haanach hattame hare hen tehorin: 
Kordom sheasaahu min habbarzel hattahor veasa ushpo min hattame hare ze tame. asa ushpo min hattahor vehakkordom min hattame hare ze tahor. shehakkol holech achar ose hammelacha: 
Kordom tahor shechasamo bevarzel tame tahor: 
Kiton sheasaahu min hattame veshulav min hattahor tahor. asaahu min hattahor veshulav min hattame tame. shehakkol holech achar hamekabbel haose melacha: 
Keli mattachot shennitma betuma shehi middivre sofrim kegon shennitma baavoda zara vechayyotze bah venishbar vehitticho vechazar veasa mimmennu keli acher hare ze safek im chazar letumato hayeshana o lo chazar: 
Kele zechuchit shennitmeu venishberu taharu kechol hakkelim vaafillu hittichan veasa mehen kelim acherim enam chozrim lattuma hayeshana lefi sheikkar tumatah middivre sofrim kemo shebbearnu lo gazru alehen betuma yeshana. vechen kele zechuchit shennishberu af al pi sheshshivrehen kelim ureuyin letashmish hoil vehem shivre kelim enan mekabbelin tuma lefi sheenan domin lichle cheres. ketzad. keara shel zechuchit shennishbera vehitkin shulayim letashmish en hashshulayim mekabbelin tuma af al pi shehen bakkeara. veim kirsem et mekom hashshever veshafo beshufin hare zo mekabbelet tuma: 
Tzelochit ketanna hannittelet beyad achat shennittal piha mekabbelet tuma mippene sheen machnisin hayyad letochah ella yotzek mimmenna. aval gedola hannittelet bishte yadayim shennittal piha tehora mippene shehi chovelet bayyad beshaa shemmachnis yado letochah. vechen tzelochit shel palyaton af al pi shehi ketanna im nittelet piha tehora mippene shechovelet beetzbao beshaa shemmotzi habboshom mittochah: 
Laginim haggedolin shennittal pihen adayin hen kelim mippene shemmatkinam hu lechivshanim: 
Kos shennifgam rubbo tahor. nifgam bo shelish hekkefo berov gavho tahor. nikkav usetamo ben bevaatz ben bezefet tahor. vehakkos vehatztzelochit shennikkevu ben millemala ben millematta tehorin: 
Hattamchuy vehakkeara shennikkevu millemala temein millematta tehorin. nisdeku im yecholin lekabbel et hachammin ketzonnin temein veim lav tehorin: 
Hakkosot hachatuchin af al pi shessiftotehem sorchin et happe mekabbelim tuma: 
Haafarkes shel zechuchit tahor shehare hu kemo machatz sheeno mekabbel: 
Zechuchit sheosin otah lemara tehora af al pi shehi mekabbelet lefi shello naaset lekabbala. hattarvad shel zechuchit shehu mekabbel af al pi shekkeshemmannicho al hashshulchan nehpach al tziddo veeno mekabbel hare ze mekabbel tuma: 
Tamchuy shel zechuchit sheasao mara mekabbel tuma. veim mittechilla asauhu lemara kede sheyyihyu devarim shemmannichin bo nirin meachorav hare ze tahor. vechol kele zechuchit en mekabbelin tuma ad shettiggamer melachtan kechol hakkelim:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 13:
Kevar bearnu bechamma mekomot sheen keli cheres mittamme ella meaviro o behesset hazzav. ushear kol hakkelim shennaga bahen hattuma nitmeu veim nichnesa tuma laaviro velo naga bahen hare hem tehorin. nimtza hattame bichli cheres tahor bechol hakkelim vehattame bechol hakkelim tahor bichli cheres. uminnayin sheen keli cheres mittamme ella meaviro shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 33)</small> "ucheli cheres asher yippol mehem el tocho" vegomer mittocho hu mittamme lo meachorav: 
Ucheshem shemmittamme meaviro kach metamme ochalin umashkin meaviro. ketzad. keli cheres shennitma venichnesu ochalin umashkin laaviro af al pi shello nagu bo hare ellu temein shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 33)</small> "kl asher betocho yitma". aval shear hakkelim hattemein enan metammein ochalin umashkin ad sheyyiggeu bahen: 
En keli cheres metamme kelim meaviro ben kele cheres ben shear kelim. ketzad. keli cheres gadol shehayu betocho kelim venichnesa tuma baaviro hu tame vechol hakkelim shebbetocho tehorin. hayu mashkin bakkelim shebbetocho nitmeu hammashkin meaviro vechozrin umetammein et hakkelim. vahare ze omer metammeecha lo timmeuni veatta timmetani: 
Keli cheres shennagu mashkin temein baachorav bilvad nitmeu achorav kishar kol hakkelim. bamme devarim amurim beshehaya lo toch. aval im en lo toch venagu bo mashkin temein hare ze tahor. shekkol sheen lo toch bichli cheres en achorav mittammein bemashkin. nagu ochalin o mashkin baachore keli cheres hattame hare ellu temein. veechad keli cheres veechad shear kol hakkelim bedavar ze shekkol hakkelim hattemein shennagu ochalin o mashkin bahen ben mittochan ben meachorehen nitmeu: 
Echad keli cheres shennichnesa tuma laaviro o shekkafahu al hattuma hammunnachat al haaretz venaasa ohel aleha shehare hattuma betocho. mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 33)</small> "el tocho" lerabbot et haohalim: 
Guma shehaya hashsheretz munnach betochah vechafa keli cheres al hagguma lo nitma shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 33)</small> "el tocho" ad shettikkanes atzmah shel tuma betocho. lefichach hashsheretz shennimtza lematta minnechushto shel tannur shehi karkait hattannur tahor sheani omer chay nafal veachshav met betoch guma zo. vechen im nimtzet machat o tabbaat lematta minnechushto af al pi shekkol hakkelim hannimtzaim temeim kemo shebbearnu hare hattannur tahor sheani omer sham hayu ad shello ba hattannur vehattannur nivna alehen velo naflu betocho. nimtzeu baddeshen hare hattannur tame sheen lo bema yitle. nimtzeu binchushto shel tannur nirin aval enan yotzin laaviro. im ofe et habbatzek vehu nogea bahen nitma hattannur keillu hayu betoch aviro. veim lav hattannur tahor keillu hayu lematta minnechushto. bee ze batzek amru bevatzek habbenoni sheeno rach beyoter velo kashe: 
Hashsheretz shennimtza beayin shel tannur beayin shel kira beayin shel kuppach im nimtza min hassafa happenimit velachutz tahor. vechen im nimtza baavir haayin tahor shehare lo nichnas laavir hattannur o hakkira o hakkuppach ella tachat ovi dafnotehen hu taluy. vaafillu haya sham kezayit min hammet tehorin ella im ken haya boovi haayin poteach tefach shehare mevi et hattuma laavir hattannur kemo shennitbaer beinyan tumat met: 
Nimtza hashsheretz bimkom hannachat haetzim min hassafa happenimit velachutz tahor. nimtza bimkom yeshivat habballan bimkom yeshivat hatztzabba bimkom yeshivat sholke hazzetim hakkol tahor: 
En hattannur velo hakkira velo shear mekomot hayekod mittammein ella im ken nimtzet hattuma min hassetima ulefanim: 
Keli cheres sheshshotin bo baale battim hammayim shebbeemtzao kemo reshet shel cheres usefato shellemala min hareshet kemo masrek vezehu hannikra tzartzur im nichnesa hattuma laavir hammasrek lemala min hareshet nitma kullo shezzehu tocho shel keli ze: 
Keli cheres shehaya lo shalosh sefayot zo lefanim mizzo hayta happenimit odefet venichnesa tuma laavir happenimit kol hoochalin vehammashkin shebbaavir shebben hassafa happenimit uven haemtzait vehachitzona tehorin. hayta haemtzait odefet venitma avirah mimmenna velifnim tame mimmenna velachutz tahor. hayta hachitzona odefet venitma avirah hakkol tame. hayu shavot kol shennitma avirah temea vehashshear tahor: 
Ilpasim zo betoch zo vesiftotehen shavot vehashsheretz baelyona o battachtona zo sheyyesh bah hashsheretz temea ushear hailpasin tehorin hen vechol hoochalin shebbahen. haya kol ilpas mehen nekuva bechones mashke vehashsheretz baelyona kol hoochalin vehammashkin shebbechol hailpasim temeim shehattuma baavir kullan kemo sheyyitbaer. haya hashsheretz battachtona hi temea vechullan tehorot shehare lo nichnas sheretz laavir haelyona veen sefat hattachtona odefet kede letamme kol hoochalin vehammashkin shebbetochah. haya hashsheretz baelyona vehayta sefat hattachtona odefet haelyona temea shehashsheretz betochah vechen hattachtona mippene shessefatah odefet hare hashsheretz baavirah ushear hailpasin shebbetoch hattachtona tehorin sheen keli cheres metamme kelim shebbetocho. veim haya benehen mashke tofeach kol sheyyesh bah mashke tofeach temea shehammashke mittamme meavir hattachtona haodefet vechozer umetamme et hailpas: 
Tavla shel cheres shehayu kearot devukot bah bitchillat maaseha vahare hakkol keli echad venitmet achat mehen lo nitmeu kullan. veim haya lattavla dofen odef shennimtzeu kol hakkearot betocho venitmet achat mehen nitmeu kullan. vechen haddin bevet hattavlin shel cheres vekalmirin hammatimot kayyotze bo: 
Bet hattavlin shel etz shennitma echad mibbattav bemashkin lo nitmeu shear habbattim. veim yesh lo dofen odef shennimtzeu kol habbattim betocho venitma echad mibbattav bemashkin nitmeu kullan shehakkol kichli echad ucheli shennitma tocho bemashkin nitma kullo. hayu battav kevuin bemasmer hare ellu chibbur ze laze letuma ulehazzaya. hayu tekuin bilvad hare ellu chibbur letuma velo lehazzaya. veim hayu battav nittalin venittanin enan chibbur lo letuma velo lehazzaya:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 14:
Kol hammatztzil betzamid patil beohel hammet matztzil betzamid potil boavir keli cheres. im hitztzil bemet hechamur din hu sheyyatztzil bichli cheres hakkal. vechol sheeno matztzil beohel hammet eno matztzil baavir keli cheres: 
Ucheshem sheen tzamid patil letuma beohel hammet kach en tzamid patil letuma baavir keli cheres. ketzad. kedera shehi melea ochalin umashkin umukkefet tzamid patil unetuna betoch hattannur hattame hare hakkedera vechol ma shebbetochah tehorin. haya hashsheretz o mashkin temein betochah umukkefet tzamid patil unetuna baavir hattannur nitma hattannur [vechen kol kayyotze baze]: 
Tabbaat temea shemmuvlaat betoch hallevena o machat temea shemmuvlaat betoch haetz venaflu laavir keli cheres nitma. af al pi sheim naga kikkar teruma beetz ze o bilvena zo tahor hare hen metammein keli cheres meaviro: 
Tarnegol shebbala sheretz o besar met venafal laavir hattannur hare ze tahor. veim met sham hattarnegol nitma hattannur. shehabbeluin bechay matztzilin miyyad keli cheres kederech shemmatztzilin beohel hammet: 
Devarim shebbetoch happe o betoch hakkematin enan kivluin. ketzad. adam shehayu mashkin temein betoch piv vekafatz piv vehichnis rosho laavir keli cheres timmeahu. vechen tahor shehayu ochalin umashkin letoch piv vehichnis rosho laavir tannur tame nitmeu ochalim shebbefiv. haya lo betoch kumto kaadasha min hashsheretz vehichniso laavir hattannur nitma hattannur af al pi shehattuma betoch hakkemet: 
Sefog shebbala mashkin temein af al pi shehu naguv mibbachutz im nafal laavir keli cheres timmeahu shessof mashke latzet. vechen chaticha shel lefet veshel gemi. charasim shennishtammeshu bahen mashkin temein veniggevu venaflu laavir keli cheres lo timmeuhu. naflu letannur vehussak nitma shessof mashke latzet. bamme devarim amurim bemashkin kallin. aval bachamurin kegon dam hannidda umeme ragleha im hayu yecholin latzet vehikpid alav sheyyetze hare ze metamme hattannur af al pi shello hussak veim eno makpid alav eno metamme ad sheyyussak veyetze hammashke. vechen begefet chadasha habbaa mimmashkin temein shehussak bah hattannur nitma shessof mashke latzet aval bishana tahor. ezo hi yeshana leachar shenem asar chodesh. veim yadua sheyyatza mimmenna mashke bishat hessek afillu leachar shalosh shanim nitma hattannur kesheyyussak: 
Keli cheres shechilleko bimchitztza missefato ad karkaito venichnesa tuma baavir echad mishshene hachalakim nitma hakkeli kullo lefi sheen derech bene adam lechallek kele cheres kederech shecholkin haohalim. lefichach tannur shechatzatzo binsarim o biriot venimtza hashsheretz bemakom echad hakkol tame: 
Keli shehayta hattuma betocho vehichnis hakkeli laavir keli cheres usefat hakkeli hattame chutz lichli cheres af al pi shehattuma mechuvvenet betoch keli cheres hare ze tahor shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 33)</small> "el tocho" lo el toch tocho: 
Vechen im haya keli cheres tame vehichnis laaviro keli acher sheyyesh bo ochalim umashkin usefat hakkeli haacher chutz lichli cheres af al pi shehoochalin vehammashkin mechuvvanin betoch keli cheres hattame hare ellu tehorin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 33)</small> "kl asher betocho yitma" velo shebbetoch tocho. ketzad. kavveret o kuppa o kedera o chemet vechayyotze bahen shehaya hashsheretz betochah veshilshel hakkuppa laavir hechavit o laavir hattannur af al pi shehashsheretz mechuvvan betoch avir hechavit hoil usefat hakkuppa o hachemet lemala missefat hechavit o missefat hattannur hare ellu tehorin. veim haya betoch hachemet o betoch hakkedera vechayyotze bahen ochalin o mashkin veshilshelan laavir hattannur o laavir hechavit hattemein hare hen tehorin. hayta hakkavveret o hakkuppa o hachemet vechayyotze bahen nekuvin enan matztzilin ella im haya hashsheretz letochan veshilshelan laavir keli cheres hattahor nitma. veim hayu ochalin o mashkin letochan veshilshelan laavir keli cheres hattame nitmeu. vechamma yihye bannekev im haya bichli shetef bemotzi zetim veim haya bichli cheres heasuy loochalin shiuro kezetim veheasuy lemashkin shiuro bechones mashke. veheasuy lechach vechach metilin oto lechumro uchesheyyinnakev keli cheres ze bechones mashke eno matztzil miyyad keli cheres: 
Satam nekev keli cheres bezefet im haya hashsheretz bichli ze veshilshelo laavir hattannur hattahor nitma sheen hatztzamid matztzil al hattuma milletamme kemo shebbearnu. aval im haya bichli ze ochalin o mashkin veshilshelo laavir hattannur hattame hare hen tehorin shehare hannekev satum. ushear kol hakkelim shessetaman bezefet vechayyotze bo eno matztzil miyyad keli cheres: 
Kavveret pechuta af al pi shessatam happechat bekash enah matztzelet miyyad keli cheres shehare enah keli: 
Hachemet vehakkefisha shennifchatu bemotzi rimmon af al pi shebbittelo mittorat keli hare ellu matztzilin miyyad keli cheres. vehu sheyyihye happechat lemala missefat keli cheres mibbachutz veyihye bet kibbul shellahen meshulshal letoch keli cheres: 
Or pashut vechayyotze bo shehaya shakua laavir keli cheres o laavir hattannur vehashsheretz betoch haor hare hattannur tame. veim haya hashsheretz battannur ochalin umashkin shebbetoch haor temein sheen matztzil miyyad keli cheres ella kelim sheyyesh lahen toch kegon hassal vehakkuppa vehachemet: 
Keli cheres shehayta tuma betocho vehaya keli cheres tahor kafuy al pi hakkeli hattame o shehaya hakkeli shehattuma devuka betocho kafuy al pi hakkeli hattahor af al pi sheavir shenehen meorav hattame betumato vehattahor betohorato shehare lo nichnesa hattuma atzmah laavir keli cheres hattahor. lefichach chavit shehayta melea mashkin tehorin unetuna lematta minnechushto shel tannur venafal sheretz letoch hattannur hare hechavit vehammashkin tehorin af al pi sheavir hattannur meorav im avir hechavit. vechen im hayta hechavit kefuya al pi hattannur ufiha laavir hattannur afillu hammashke shebbeshule hechavit tahor:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 15:
En keli cheres mekabbel tuma ad shettiggamer melachto. umeemotay hu gemar melachto mishsheyyitzrefo bechivshan. hattannur mishsheyyassikennu leefot sufganin. hakkira mishsheyyassikenna kede levashshel aleha betzat hattarnegolin terufa unetuna beilpas. hakkuppach im asaahu laafiyya shiuro ketannur asaahu levishshul shiuro kechira: 
Tannur shehitchil livnoto im haya gadol mishsheyyatchil bo arbaa tefachim veyassikennu mekabbel tuma. veim haya katan mishsheyyatchil bo tefach veyassikennu. hakkira mishsheyyatchil bah shalosh etzbaot veyassikenna. hakkuppach im asaahu laafiyya hare hu ketannur veim levashshel hare hu kechira: 
Tannur shehussak meachorav o shehussak mibbet haumman o shehussak shello ledaat hoil vehussak mikkol makom hare ze mekabbel tuma. maase shennafla deleka betannur bichfar min hakkefarim uva maase lifne bet din veamru mekabbel tuma: 
Tannur shehissiko lihyot tzole bo hare ze mekabbel tuma. lelabben bo unin shel pishtan tahor sheen ze ose melacha beguf hattannur: 
Tannur shechatzatzo lishnayim vehissik echad mechalakav venitma bemashkin hu tame vachavero tahor. nitma besheretz vechayyotze bo mittumot shel tora hakkol tame. veovi shebbenehen tame. husseku shenehen venitma echad mehen bemashkin baavir cholkin et avyo hameshammesh letame tame letahor tahor. bamme devarim amurim bizman shechatzatzo veachar kach hissiko. aval hissiko veachar kach chatzatzo venitma echad mehen afillu bemashkin nitma hakkol: 
Tannur o kira shel even tehorin leolam. veshel mattechet tehorin mishshum tannur vechirayim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 la)</small> "yuttatz" et sheyyesh lo netitza. umetammein mishshum kele mattachot. ketzad. en mittammein meaviran velo bimchubbar lakkarka ketannur vechirayim veim naga bahen tuma afillu meachorehen mittammein kishar kele mattachot veim nitmeu bemet naasin av tuma kishar kele mattachot veyesh lahen tohora bemikve: 
Tannur shel mattechet shennikkav o nifgam o nisdak usetamo betit o sheasa lo tefela shel tit o musaf shel tit hare ze mittamme mishshum tannur. vechamma yihye bannekev. kede sheyyetze bo haur. vechen bechira. veim asa lakkira pitputim shel tit mittammea mishshum kira. merchah betit ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz adayin enah mekabbelet tuma: 
Tannur sheeno mechubbar baaretz afillu taluy betzavvar haggamal hare ze tame mishshum tannur shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 la)</small> "temeim hem" bechol makom: 
Kur shel tzorfe mattachot sheyyesh bo bet shefita mittamme kechira vechen kirat shel ose zechuchit im yesh bo bet shefita mekabbelet tuma: 
Kivshan shel sayyadin veshel zoggin veshel yotzrin tehorin. happurena im yesh lah dofen mittammea: 
Avanim shechibberan zo lazo vaasaan tannur im asa lo tefela mibbifnim umibbachutz hare ze ketannur lechol davar umittamme meaviro. veim tefalo mibbachutz bilvad mittamme bemagga velo baavir. chibber avanim lattannur velo chibberan zo lazo mittammeot im hattannur. chibberan zo lazo velo chibberan lattannur hare hen ketira. chafar baaretz veasa tira tahor. vetirat hakkira tahor: 
Shete chaviyyot ushene ilpasin sheasaan kira mittammein baavir uvemagga. vetochan shel chaviyyot tahor. voovi hechaviyyot cholkin oto hameshammesh et hakkira tame vehameshammesh et toch hechavit tahor: 
Haose shelosha pitputin baaretz vechibberan betit lihyot shofet alehen et hakkedera hare zo temea mishshum kira. kava shelosha masmerin baaretz lihyot shofet alehen et hakkedera af al pi sheasa beroshah makom betit shetteshev hakkedera hare zo tehora kechira shel mattechet. vechen avanim shello mercham betit shehu shofet alehen enan mekabbelot tuma keillu hi kira shel even: 
Haose shete avanim kira vechibberan betit mittammea. chibber et haachat betit vehashsheniyya lo chibberah enah mekabbelet tuma: 
Haeven shehu shofet aleha veal hattannur aleha veal hakkira aleha veal hakkuppach temea. aleha veal hakkotel aleha veal hassela enah mekabbelet tuma: 
Kirat hattabbachim shehu noten even betzad even vechullan mechubbarot betit nitmet achat mehen lo nitmeu kullan: 
Shalosh avanim shechibberan betit vaasaan shete kirot ben shechibberan zo lazo velo chibberan lakkarka ben shechibberan bakkarka velo chibberan zo lazo im nitmet achat mishshete hakkirot haeven haemtzait hameshammesh mimmenna lakkira hattemea tame vehameshammesh mimmenna lakkira hattehora tahor. nittela haeven hachitzona shel kira hattehora huchleta haemtzait kullah letuma. nittela hachitzona shel kira hattemea tahara haeven haemtzait kullah. nitmeu shete hachitzonot im hayta haeven haemtzait gedola noten mimmenna lechira zo kede shefita mitztziddah velakkira hashsheniyya kede shefita mikkan vehashshear tahor. veim hayta ketanna hakkol tame. nittela haemtzait im yachol lishpot al shetayim chitzonot yora gedola hare hi temea. hayu meruchakin yeter mizze tehora. hechezir et haemtzait hare hakkol tahor keshehaya. merchah betit mekabbel tuma mikkan ulehabba vehu sheyyassikenna lechol achat mehen kede levashshel aleha et habbetza: 
Shete avanim sheasaan kira venitmet vesamach leeven zo mimmenna even achat mikkan velazo even achat mikkan hare chatzi kol even mishshete avne hakkira harishona tame vachatzi haeven tahor. nittelu hashshetayim hattehorot shessamach chazru hashshetayim shel kira letumatan: 
Duchan shel cheres sheyyesh lo bet kibbul hakkederot veharemetz natun betocho tahor mishshum kira vetame mishshum keli kibbul. lefichach im haya mechubbar baaretz tahor kishar hakkelim veim nikkav eno mekabbel tuma kichli kibbul. ma sheen ken bechira. hatztzedadin shello hannogea bahen eno tame mishshum kira. harachav shello sheyyoshvin alav bishat bishshul mittamme im nitma hadduchan. vechen hakkofe et hassal uvana kira al gabbah hare zo temea mishshum keli etz lo mishshum kira lefichach enah mekabbelet tuma meavirah kechira:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 16:
Tannur gadol sheyarav arbaa tefachim vehakkatan sheyarav rubbo. ketzad. im nishbar baggadol arbaa uvakkatan rubbo mekabbel tuma pachot mikkan eno mekabbel tuma. vechen im nitma venittetzo ad sheshshiyyer bo pachot mearbaa baggadol o befachot merov bakkatan tahor. nishar bo arbaa o rov bakkatan adayin hu betumato. vehakkira sheyareha shalosh etzbaot. hakkuppach sheasaahu laafiyya shiuro ketannur. levishshul shiuro kechira: 
Tannur shennitma velo ratza lechatteto ketzad metaharin oto. cholko lishlosha chalakim vegorer et hattefela sheal hacharasim ad shennimtza kol cheres mehen omed al haaretz belo tit al gabbav. chilleko lishnayim echad gadol veechad katan haggadol tame vehakkatan tahor. chilleko lishnayim beshave kol echad mehen tame lefi shei efshar lechavven. aval tavla shel cheres sheyyesh lah dofen shennechleka lishnayim tehora. veim haya echad gadol veechad katan haggadol tame: 
Tannur shechilleko lishlosha veechad gadol kishnayim haggadol tame vehashshenayim hakketannim tehorin. chatacho chulyot lerachbo im haya gova kol chulya vechulya pachot mearbaa tefachim tahor. chazar vesidder hachulyot zo al gabbe zo vehimriach alehem betit vehecheziro tannur keshehaya hare zo kemo sheasa tannur acher veeno mekabbel tuma ella mikkan ulehabba vehu sheyyassikennu kede leefot bo sufganin achar shemmercho. hirchik mimmennu et hattefela venatan chol o tzerorot ben hachulyot uven hattefela eno mekabbel tuma leolam vezehu sheamru hannidda vehattehora ofot bo vehu tahor. hayta bo chulya achat sheyyesh bah arbaa tefachim hi mittammea bemagga velo mittammet baavir ushear hachulyot tehorot: 
Tannur shebba mechuttach mibbet haumman veasa lo semochin shemmekabbetzin oto lihyot keechad unetanam alav vehu tahor venitma kesheyyasir et hassomchin oto yithar vaafillu hechziran hare hu tahor. mercho betit mekabbel tuma lehabba veeno tzarich lehassiko shekkevar hussak: 
Tannur shechatacho chulyot venatan chol ben chulya lechulya vetach betit al hakkol mibbachutz hare ze mekabbel tuma: 
Yorat haarviyyim shehu chofer baaretz vetach betit im yuchal hattit laamod bifne atzmo mekabbelet tuma veim lav tahor: 
Hammevi shivre cheres vedibbekan ze baze vaasaan tannur veasa lo tefela mibbayit umibbachutz vehissiko hare ze mekabbel tuma af al pi sheen bechol echad mehen kashshiur: 
Pittam shekkirzelo vaasaahu tannur veasa lo tefela michutz af al pi shemmekabbel al dafnotav kashshiur hare ze tahor shekkeli cheres shettahar en lo tuma leolam ella im ken asaahu tannur veasa lo tefela mibbayit umibbachutz: 
Tannur shel sedakin sheasa tefela lechol echad veechad umekom hassedakin megulle eno mekabbel tuma. natan tit o sid o gafsis al gabbe hassedakin hare ze mittamme. natan alehen charsit o zefet vegafrit shaava ushemarim batzek o gelalim tahor. ze hakkelal davar sheen osin mimmennu tannur eno mechabber et hassedakin: 
Sedek tannur shennetano kelappe zavit umereach betit min hatztzedadin tahor: 
Daf shel tannur shennetano bezavit lihyot ofe bo tahor. veim yesh bo rov tannur mekabbel tuma: 
Tannur shennatan bo afar ad chetzyo im nitma meaviro bilvad eno mittamme ella meafar ulemala veim nitma bemagga venaga tuma bo mittocho nitma kullo af meafar ulematta: 
Hakkira mekom shefitat shete kederot vehakkuppach mekom shefitat kedera achat. lefichach kira shennechleka learkah tehora lerachbah adayin mekabbelet tuma. hakkuppach shennechlak ben learko ben lerachbo tahor: 
Hakkelatot shel baale battim shennifchata karkaitah im haya omek happechat pachot mishshelosha tefachim hare zo mekabbelet tuma sheim yassik bappechat millematta titbashshel hakkedera millemala. haya happechat amok shelosha o yeter enah mekabbelet tuma shehare haesh rechoka min hakkedera veenah beshela. natan even o tzeror al pi happechat adayin hi betohoratah. mercho betit naaset haeven karka hakkira umekabbelet tuma mikkan ulehabba:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 17:
Kol yedot hakkelim hare hen kechelim veim nitma hakkeli nitoma yado hatztzarich lah betashmisho vesheen tzarich lah tahor kemo sheyyitbaer. lefichach haeven hayyotzet min hattannur tefach umin hakkira shalosh etzbaot chibbur veim nitma hattannur vehakkira nitmeu avanim ellu. voochalin umashkin hannogin baavanim ellu nitmeu. veim nagu bechutz letefach shel tannur o bechutz leshalosh etzbaot shel kira tehorin: 
Hakkuppach asaahu laafiyya shiuro ketannur. asaahu levishshul shiuro kechira: 
Musaf hattannur shel baale battim tahor veshel nachtomin tame betumat hattannur mippene shessomech alav et hashshippud. kayyotze bo musaf yora shel sholke zetim tame veshel tzabbaim tahor: 
Ateret hakkira tehora. vetirat hattannur vehu hammakom habbanuy betziddo shemmannichin bo et happat beet rediyyatah bizman shehi gevoha arbaa tefachim temea betumat hattannur. pachot mearbaa tefachim tehora lefi sheenah chibbur lo. veim chibberah lattannur afillu al shalosh avanim temea: 
Bet happach uvet hattavlin uvet hanner shebbakkira im nitmet hakkira bemagga nitmeu kullan veim nitmet baavir lo nitmeu lefi sheenan chibbur lah ella middivre sofrim. ulefichach asu lah hekker kede shello yissarfu al maggaan teruma vekadashim. vechen kol sheanu omrin beinyan ze shehu mittamme bemagga veeno mittamme baavir eno chibbur ella middivrehem veasu lo hekker ze kede shello yissarfu alav kadashim ella tolin: 
Chatzar hakkira bizman shehi gevoha shalosh etzbaot hare zo chibbur veim nitmet hakkira o chatzerah ben baavir ben bemagga nitmet hashsheniyya. hayta hechatzer pechuta mikkan venitmet achat mehen bemagga nitmet hashsheniyya. aval im nitmet achat mehen meavirah bilvad en chavertah temea lefi sheenah chibbur lah ella middivrehem. hayta chatzar hakkira mufreshet mimmenna bizman shehi gevoha shalosh etzbaot hare zo chibbur lah ben letumat magga ben letumat avir. hayta pachot mikkan o shehayta hechatzer chalaka veen lah safa en chibbur lah veim nitmet hakkira ben meavirah ben bemagga hechatzer tehora vechen im nitmet hechatzer hakkira tehora: 
Pitpute kira shelosha haya gova kol echad mehen shalosh etzbaot o pachot im nitmet hakkira ben bemagga ben baavir nitmeu shelashtan. vechen im hayu arbaa. nittal echad mehen im nitmet hakkira bemagga nitmeu shene happitputim shennisharu veim nitmet baavir lo nitmeu immah. asa lah shene happitputim ze keneged ze im nitmet hakkira bemagga nitmeu. veim nitmet baavir lo nitmeu. hayu happitputim gevohin mishshalosh etzbaot ulematta mittammein immah ben shennitmet bemagga ben shennitmet baavir. umishshalosh ulemala mittammein immah im nitmet bemagga aval im nitmet meavirah bilvad en mittammein immah. hayu meshuchin min hassafa betoch shalosh etzbaot mittammein immah ben shennitmet bemagga ben shennitmeta baavir. hayu chutz leshalosh etzbaot mittammein immah im nitmet bemagga veim nitmet baavir bilvad en mittammein immah. veen medakdekin bechol hashshiurin haellu shekkullan hen middivre sofrim:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 18:
Keli cheres eno mekabbel tuma ad sheyyihye mekabbel veasuy lekabbalo. aval im lo haya lo bet kibbul o shehaya mekabbel velo naasa lekabbala eno mekabbel tuma kelal lo min hattora velo middivre sofrim. lefichach hakkisse vehammitta vehassafsal vehammenora vehashshulchan shel cheres. vechen kol kayyotze bahen mikkelim sheen lahem toch enan mekabbelin tuma. vechen hassilonot shehammayim mehallechin bahen af al pi shehen kefufin veaf al pi shehen mekabbelin hare hen tehorin mippene shello naasu lekabbala ella kede sheyyetzu mehen hammayim. vechen chavit shel shayyatim vechavit haddefuna beshule hammachatz hoil venaaset kemo bet yad shennosin bah hammachatz velo naaset lekabbala enah mekabbelet tuma: 
Panas shehaya bo bet kibbul shemen mekabbel tuma vesheen bo tahor. vechen megufat hayyotzrim sheyyesh lah toch temea: 
Mashpech shel baale battim tahor. veshel rochlin mittamme mippene shemmattehu al tziddo umeriach bo lallokeach: 
Kissuy kadde yayin vechadde shemen vehechaviyyot tehorot shello naasu lekabbala. veim hitkinan letashmish mittammein: 
Kissuy hailpas bizman shehu nakuv veyesh lo chiddud tahor. veim eno nakuv veen lo chiddud mittamme mippene shehaishsha mesannenet letocho et hayyarak. ze hakkelal kol hameshammesh bichli cheres keshehu kafuy tahor: 
Titros af al pi shehu nakuv umotzi perutot mittamme shehare hammayim mitkannesin batztzedadin vehen asuyin lekabbala: 
Hallappid shel cheres shemmannichin matliyyot habbegadim vehashshemen betocho vehu dolek mittamme. vechen keli shemmannichin tachat hannerot lekabbel hashshemen mittamme: 
Gistera shemmannichin tachat hakkelim lekabbel mashkin hannozlin min hakkeli mekabbelin tuma: 
Sefina shel cheres af al pi shehi mekabbelet enah mekabbelet tuma sheen hassefina bichlal hakkelim haamurin battora ben hi shel cheres ben hi shel etz ben gedola ben ketanna: 
Kol hakkelim shennishberu venifseda tzuratan en shivrehen mekabbelin tuma af al pi sheotan hashshevarim reuyin letashmish. chutz mishshivre kele cheres sheim haya bahen cheres harauy lekabbel hare hu mekabbel tuma shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 33)</small> "vechol keli cheres" mippi hashshemua lamdu shezze lo ba lerabbot ella shivre kele cheres. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya lecheres ze toch lekabbel bo hammashkin keshehaya hacheres yoshev lo samuch. aval im eno yachol lekabbel ella im ken somchin oto eno mekabbel tuma: 
Hacheres sheeno yachol leshev kede sheyyekabbel mippene azno o shehaya bo chiddud vehachiddud machrio letzad acher hare ze tahor af al pi shennittela haozen o nishbar hachiddud shekkol keli cheres shettahar shaa achat en lo tuma leolam: 
Kele cheres sheshshulehen chaddin kemizrakot shennishberu veshulehen mekabbelin af al pi sheenan mekabbelin ella im ken nismechu kegon shule hakkurfiot vehakkosot hare ellu mekabbelin tuma. shellechach naasu mittechillatan sheyyihyu shulehen mekabbelin bismicha o baachiza: 
Kamma yekabbel hacheres veyihye mekabbel tuma. im haya hakkeli keshehaya shalem umechil kede sikkat adam katan ad chaviyyot shehen mekabbelot kisah o karov venishberu venishar bacharasim ben mikkarkeehen ben middafnehen cheres shehu mekabbel keshehu yoshev reviit hare ze mekabbel tuma: 
Haya hakkeli mechavit hammechila kisa ad chavit hamechila satayim o yeter venishbera im haya bacheres hannishar kede lekabbel chatzi log hare ze mekabbel tuma. haya hakkeli mechavit hamechila satayim ad chatzavim gedolim venishberu im nishar mehen cheres hamekabbel log hare ze mekabbel tuma. hayu hacharasim mekabbelin pachot mishshiurin ellu en mekabbelin tuma: 
Keli cheres katan kegon happach vechayyotze bo shennishbar venishar mikkarkaito cheres hamekabbel kol shehu keshehu yoshev vehaya chad beyoter shennimtza kichli katan hare ze mekabbel tuma. veim nishar middafnotehen cheres hamekabbel eno mekabbel tuma lefi sheddafnot kelim ellu vechayyotze bahen keshavin hen veen lahen toch hannikkar venimtzeu kifshute kele cheres: 
Chezkat charasim hannimtzaim bechol makom tehorim chutz mehannimtzaim bevet hayyotzer mippene sherubban gisterayot hen lakkelim vehaggistera mekabbelet tuma af al pi shehi mishshivre kelim:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 19:
Kamma shiur hashshever sheyyishshaver keli cheres veyithar mittumato im haya tame. o lo yekabbel tuma im haya tahor. heasuy loochalin mishsheyyinnakev bemotzi zetim. veheasuy lemashkin mishsheyyinnakev bemachnis mashkin, keshemmannichin oto al hammashke yikkanes hammashke lakkeli bannekev. heasuy lechach ulechach metilin oto lechumro vahare hu mekabbel tuma ad sheyyinnakev bemotzi zayit. velo amru bemotzi mashke ella begistera bilvad lefi shehi asuya lekabbel hammashkin hannozlim min hakkelim veim hotzia mashkin hare ze batel tashmishah: 
Chamesh middot bichli cheres. nikkav bemotzi mashke tahor millehittamme mishshum gistera vaadayin hu chashuv keli lekaddesh bo me chattat. nikkav bechones mashke eno rauy lekaddesh bo me chattat vaadayin keli hu chashuv lehacheshir hazzeraim bemashkin hattelushin bo kemo shebbearnu. nikkav keshoresh katan en hammayim shebbetocho machshirin et hazzeraim vahare hen kemo sheenan bakkeli vaadayin keli hu chashuv lekabbel bo zetim umekabbel tuma. nikkav bemotzi zetim tahor vahare hu kichle gelalim vaavanim sheen mekabbelin tuma vaadayin keli hu chashuv lehatztzil betzamid patil ad sheyyippachet rubbo kemo shebbearnu betumat met (beferek shenem asar): 
Hechavit shiurah keegozim. hailpas vehakkedera shiuran kezetim. vechen areva shel cheres afillu hayta gedola umachzeket arbaim sea belach venifchata bemotzi zetim af al pi shehu mattah al tzidda velash bah tehora shemmittechillatah lo naaset lechach: 
Happach vehatteni shiuran beshemen. vehatztzartzur shiuro bemayim: 
Ner shennittal piv tahor. veshel adama shehussak piv biftila eno mekabbel tuma veeno bichlal kele cheres ad sheyyussak kullo bakkivshan kichle cheres: 
Chavit shennifchata ucheshemmattin otah al dafnah mekabbelet o shennechleka kemin shete arevot adayin hi mekabbelet tuma. nitraa veenah yechola lehittaltel bachatzi kav gerogarot tehora: 
Chavit shennittelu azneha hare hi kegistera afillu ozen achat. nisdeka lematta meazneha af al pi sheazneha kayyamot hare zo kegistera. veim asaah mittechilla shello beaznayim niddonet kechavit: 
Chavit shennisdeka bakkivshan venimtza shehi kishte gisteraot. im mishshennigmera melachtah nisdeka kol gistera mehen mekabbelet tuma. veim nisdeka kodem shettiggamer melachtah veachar kach nisrefa bakkivshan tehora. veheach yivvada davar ze. im hayu shevareha shavin vetochah maadim ad shello nigmera melachtah nisdeka. en shevareha shavin veen tochah maadim beyadua sheachar shennigmera melachtah nishbera umekabbelet tuma kishar shivre kele cheres haruyin letashmish: 
Gistera shennitraa veenah mekabbelet mashkin af al pi shemmekabbelet ochalin hare zo tehora sheenah asuya ella lekabbel mashkin haddolfin kemo shebbearnu veim hayta dolefet en osin gistera legistera. vechen gistera shennifchata o shennechleka lishtayim tehora shello amru sheyarim shel sheyarim mittammein ella sheyare kele cheres bilvad hen shemmittammein: 
Gistera shechiddudin yotzin mimmenna ben shehayta yoshevet ben shehayta mutta al tziddah kol hamekabbel min hachiddudin zetim kesheyyitmalle haggistera zetim metamme bemagga uchenegdo mittamme baavir vechol sheen mekabbel immah bezetim mittamme bemagga veen kenegdo mittamme baavir: 
Ketzad mittamme bemagga veen kenegdo mittamme baavir. sheim naga hattuma baggistera mittochah mittamme hachiddud. nichnesa hattuma baavir haggistera afillu hayta keneged hachiddud lo nitma hachiddud: 
Vechetzad kenegdo mittamme baavir. sheim hayta hattuma baavir haggistera keneged hachiddud nitma hachiddud im haggistera. veal derech ze hu bechol makom shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 17)</small> "bichli cheres" uvetannur vechirayim mittamme bemagga uchenegdo baavir o en mittamme kenegdo baavir. vechen kol tumat magga haamura beinyan keli cheres o tannur vechirayim hu shettigga hattuma bahen mittochan vechol tumat avir hu shello tigga hattuma kelal ella tikkanes laavir bilvad: 
Chavit shennitraa utefalah biglalim af al pi shehu notel et haggelalim vehacharasim noflim hare zo mekabbelet tuma mippene shello batal shem keli mealeha. nishbera vedibbek charaseha achar sheppershu o shehevi charasim mimmakom acher utefalam biglalim af al pi shennotel et haggelalim vacharaseha omdin hare zo tehora mippene shebbatal mealeha shem keli. haya bahen cheres machazik reviit keneged oto hacheres bilvad mittamme baavir mippene shehu keli bifne atzmo. ushear hechavit eno mittamme ad shettigga bah hattuma mittochah mippene sheenah keli shalem: 
Chavit shennikkeva vesatam hannekev bezefet veachar kach nishbera im yesh bacheres hassatum bezefet kede lehachazik reviit hare ze mekabbel tuma mippene shehu mishshivre hechavit velo batal shem keli mealeha. aval cheres shennikkav achar shepperash min hakkeli vesatam hannekev bezefet af al pi shehu machazik reviit tahor. shehacheres shennikkav batal shem keli mealav vetahar vechol shettahar bichli cheres shaa achat en lo tuma leolam: 
Kumekumos shennikkav vaasaahu bezefet tahor sheeno yachol lekabbel hachammin ketzonen. vechen kele hazzefet vehashshaava vechayyotze bahen tehorin veenan bichlal hakkelim: 
Mashpech shel cheres sheppekako bezefet eno mekabbel tuma sheen hazzefet mesimo keli kibbul. aval mashpech shel etz shessetamo hare ze kichli kibbul umittamme:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 20:
Kevar bearnu shekkol yad hakkelim shehakkeli tzarich lah bishat tashmisho hare hi chashuva keguf hakkeli lehittamme uletamme. lefichach hattofel keli cheres habbari im nitma hakkeli hare ochlin umashkin hannogin battefela tehorin sheen hakkeli tzarich litfela zo. aval hattofel et keli cheres haraua hare hattefela chashuva keguf hakkeli. vechen hamehaddek et hakkeruya shel cheres haddolin bah hammayim im chippa otah beor o biklaf vechayyotze bahen im hayta reua hare hen kegufah: 
Hattofel keli cheres lihyot mevashshel bo eno chibbur. tafal kelim lihyot zofet bahen chibbur: 
Chavit shennikkeva vaasaah bezefet bevaatz vegafrit besid uvigfasim enan chibbur ushear kol haddevarim chibbur: 
Devarim hallachin hammeshuchin shettoflin bahen happitasin shel mayim kede shello yidlof hakkeli hare hen kegufo shel keli sheafillu nitma hakkeli meaviro ochalin umashkin hannogin battefela temein. vechen tefelo shel tannur hare hu kecheres hattannur vehu sheyyihye boovi hattefela ad tefach shehu tzarko shel tannur aval yeter al tefach eno mitztzorech hattannur vehannogin beyeter al tefach meavyo tehorim. tefelat hakkira avyo shalosh etzbaot: 
Chavit shennikkeva usetamah bezefet yoter mitztzarkah hannogea betzarkah tame uveyeter mitztzarkah tahor. zefet shennatfa al chavit hannogea bah tahor: 
Mecham shettefalo bechemar uvecharsit venitma hannogea bachemar tame vehannogea bacharsit tahor sheen hacharsit mitchabber lakkeli: 
Megufat hechavit shettafal betit aleha veal hechavit enah chibbur lah veim nagu mashkin temein bachavit lo nitmet hammegufa veim nagu bammegufa lo nitmeu achore hechavit: 
Kele nechoshet shezzefatan en hazzefet chibbur veim leyayin hare ze keguf hakkeli: 
Batzek shebbesidke haareva shennaga bo sheretz im befesach hoil veissuro chashuv chotzetz velo nitmet haareva. veim bishar yemot hashshana im haya makpid alav haareva tehora veim rotze bekiyyumo hare hu kaareva venitmet haareva: 
Hammeshichot vehartzuot shebbemitpechot hassefarim veshebbemitpechot hattinokot tefurot chibbur ukeshurot enan chibbur. vechen retzuot shebbammader veshebbassak veshebbakuppa aval shebbeazne kele cheres afillu tefurot enan chibbur sheen chibburin lichle cheres: 
Yad kordom hayyotze meacharav shalosh etzbaot chibbur vehayyeter al shalosh hannogea bo tahor. yad kordom millefanav tefach hassamuch labbarzel chibbur yeter al ken hannogea bo tahor: 
Sheyare happargal tefach. veyad makkevet shel mefatteche avanim tefach. yad kurnas shel zehavim tefachayim veshel charashim shelosha. sheyare malmad habbakar arbaa tefachim samuch laddarvan. yad kordom shechofrin bo bedidin shel mayim arbaa tefachim. veyad kordom shel nikkush chamishsha. veyad ben pattish chamishsha. veshel pattish shishsha. vechen yad kordom shel bikkua veshel adir shishsha. yad makkevet shel sattatin shishsha. sheyare hammardea hassamuch lecharchur shel mattechet shebberosh hammardea shiva tefachim. yad hammagrefa shel baale battim shemona tefachim. veshel sayyadin asara. vechol hayyeter al ze im ratza lekayyemo tame. yad kol meshammeshe haur kegon hashshippudin vehaaskelaot afillu arukkin kol shehen temein: 
Makkel sheasaahu yad lekordom hare hu chibbur lattuma bishat melacha veim naga tuma bammakkel keshehu choresh o mevakkea bo nitma hakkordom veim naga bakkordom nitma hammakkel. vechen haddeyusetar shehen kishne kelim vehammasmer mechabberan lihyot mesech alehen hare hen chibbur bishat melacha. kevao bekora hare ze mekabbel tuma veen hakkora chibbur lo. asa ketzat hakkora deyusetar kol shehu min hakkora letzorech haddeyusetar chibbur laddeyusetar. vehannogea bishar hakkora tahor sheen kol hakkora chibbur: 
Agala shennitmet hannogea baol uvakkatrav uvaetz uveavot afillu bishat melacha tahor. vehannogea bacherev uvabborech uvayyetzul uvaayin shel mattechet uvallechayayim uvairain tame. vechen megera shennitmet hannogea beyadah mikkan umikkan tame. vehannogea bachut uvammeshicha uvaamma uvassenifin shellah tahor sheen ellu chibbur lah. aval hannogea bammalben shel massar haggadol tame: 
Machbesh shel charash shennitma haromach shebbo hannogea bammachbesh tahor. megera shennitma hannogea bakkashtanit shehi lefufa alav tahor sheenah chibbur. keshet shehayta metucha vehachetz mashuch immah venitma hachetz hannogea bayyeter uvakkeshet tahor vaafillu keshehi metucha. vechen metzudat haishut shennitma hachetz shellah lo nitmet hammetzuda afillu keshehi metucha. vechen massechet nesucha shennitmet bishat haarig hannogea bakkoved haelyon vehattachton uvannirim uvakkeros uvachut sheheeviro al gabbe argaman uvaira sheenah atid lehachezirah tahor shekkol ellu enan chibbur leveged. aval hannogea benefesh hammassechet uvashsheti haomed uvakkefel sheheeviro al gabbe argaman uvaira shehu lehachezirah tame shekkol ellu chibburin leveged: 
Hannogea batztzemer sheal haima uvaashvaya tahor. hannogea bappika ad shello peraah tame mishshepperaah tahor: 
Hachut shehishshilo lemachat afillu kashur mishshene tzedadin eno chibbur. hichniso leveged hachut chibbur labbeged veen hammachat chibbur labbeged. veen hachut kullo chibbur labbeged ella kol shehu letzorech hattefira chibbur sheeno letzorech hattefira eno chibbur. hachut shepperesh min habbeged afillu mea amma kullo chibbur. chevel shekkashur becheres afillu mea amma kullo chibbur. kashar bo chevel echad min hakkesher ulefanim chibbur min hakkesher velachutz eno chibbur. hachevel shehu kashur bekuppa eno chibbur ella im ken tafar:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 21:
Hachutin hayyotzin min haarig veshebbitchillat hayeria veshebbesofah vehen hannikrain nimin kamma shiuran. shel sadin veshel sudarin veshel tzaif veshel pilyon shel rosh shesh etzbaot. veshel chaluk shehu karua mittechillato vead sofo veachar shellovshin oto mekabbetzin oto belulaot shiur chutav eser etzbaot. hassagis vehardid vehattallit shalosh etzbaot. vechol hayyeter al hashshiurin haellu hannogea bo tahor af al pi shehabbeged tame bemidras o bishar tumot. veen tzarich lomar sheim naga tuma bayyeter shehabbeged tahor: 
Nime hakkippa shel rosh. vehammasve shemmannichin haarviyyim al penehem. vehakkilkalin hashshezurin min hassear. vehappunda shellovesh haadam al besaro. vehassimla vehappargod shemmannichin al happetachim kemo parochet. nimehen kol shehen: 
Mishkolet shennitmet hare shenem asar tefach min hachut shellah chibbur lah. vechol hannogea bechutz lishnem asar tefach tahor. umishkolet shel charashim shemona asar tefach. veshel bannain chamishshim amma. vehayyeter al middot ellu af al pi shehu rotze bekiyyumo tahor: 
Mishkolot shel sayyadin veshel tzayyarin afillu arukkin kol shehen temein: 
Chut moznayim shel zehavim. shel peles. veshel shokle argaman tov sheochez hashshokel bo vetole hammoznayim miyyado shalosh etzbaot. kane shellah vechuteha kol shehen. chute moznayim shel mochre ashashiyyot shel mattachot vechayyotze bahen shelosha tefachim. kane shellah vechuteha shenem asar tefachim. chut moznayim shel chenvanim veshel baale battim tefach. kene hammoznayim vechuteha shishsha tefachim. chut moznayim shel tzammarim veshel shokle zechuchit tefachayim. kene moznayim vechuteha tisha tefachim. vehayyeter al hashshiurin ellu enan chibbur: 
Hachevel shemmesargin hammittot meematay hu chibbur lattuma mishsheyyesareg bo shelosha battim. vehannogea bachevel min hakkesher ulefanim tame min hakkesher velachutz ad shalosh etzbaot tame mippene shehen tzerachav shel kesher hare hen mikkelal hammitta. vechutz leshalosh etzbaot tahor sheeno letzorech hakkeli sheafillu pesako en hakkesher nittar: 
Chevel hayyotze min hammitta shehi temea ad sof arbaa tefachim hannogea bo tahor sheeno mitztzarche hammitta lefi sheeno rauy lichlum. mittechillat chamishsha vead sof asara tame mippene shettolin bo et hammittot. measara velachutz tahor mippene shehu yeter al tzorech hammitta: 
Avnet shel arig shemmakkifin oto al hammitta kede lekabbetz evareha vehu hannikra mizran shemmiktzato yotza min hammitta ad asara tefachim hare hu mitztzarche hammitta. yeter al ken eno mitztzarche hammitta. umizran shebbala im nishar mimmennu shiva tefachim kede laasot mimmennu chevek lachamor hare ze mekabbel tuma: 
Mitta shehayta temea midras umizran yotze mimmenna ad asara tefachim hare hu av tuma kammitta atzmah vehakkol midras. measara velachutz hare hu kemagga midras. daras hazzav al hammizran hayyotze measara ulefanim hare hammitta kullah midras. measara velachutz tehora. bamme devarim amurim lemidras. aval lishar tumot afillu mea amma kullo chibbur. ketzad. mizran shehu karuch al hammitta vehichnis ketzato leohel hammet o shennaga sheretz biktzato o shennaflu mashkin temein al miktzato nitmet hammitta vaafillu haya hakkatze shennitma yotze min hammitta mea amma: 
Mitta hattemea midras vecharach lah mizran hakkol tame midras. hifrisho hammitta midras keshehayta vehammizran magga midras. hayta temea tumat shiva vecharach lah mizran kullah temea tumat shiva. hifrisho hi temea keshehayta vehammizran tame tumat erev. hayta temea tumat erev vecharach lah mizran hakkol tame tumat erev. hifrisho hi temea tumat erev vehammizran tahor: 
Mitta shekkarach aleha mizran venaga bahen hammet hakkol tame tumat shiva. pershu tame tumat shiva. naga bah sheretz vechayyotze bahen temein tumat erev. pershu temein tumat erev: 
Kera shehayta temea midras vechibberah lemitta hammitta kullah midras. persha hakkera temea midras keshehayta vehammitta magga midras. vechen im hayta hakkera temea tumat shiva vechibberah lemitta hammitta kullah temea shiva keillu naga hammet bechera shellah. veim hizza al hammitta tihara vehakkera bichlalah. veim persha kodem hazzaya hakkera temea tumat shiva keshehayta vehammitta temea tumat erev. haya hakkera temea tumat erev vechibberah lammitta hakkol tame tumat erev. persha hi temea tumat erev vehammitta tehora sheen hattame tumat erev min hammet metamme lo adam velo kelim mippene shehu valad kemo shebbearnu. vechen haddin beshen shel mader shennitma bemet veachar kach chibbero lammader:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 22: Kamma shiur habbeged lehittamme shelosha tefachim al shelosha tefachim lemidras. veshalosh etzbaot al shalosh etzbaot mechuvvanot im hammelel letumat hammet o lishar tumot. bamme devarim amurim bevigde tzemer ufishtim. aval begadim shel shear minin en mekabbelin tuma mikkol hattumot ella im ken haya bahen shelosha tefachim al shelosha tefachim o yeter. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 32)</small> "o veged" mippi hashshemua lamdu shebba hakkatuv lerabbot shelosha tefachim al shelosha tefachim kishar begadim lattuma. bamme devarim amurim bikraim min habbegadim. aval haoreg beged bifne atzmo kol shehu hare ze mekabbel shear tumot chutz mittumat midras sheen mekabbel otah ella harauy lemidras:

Habbegadim heavim beyoter kegon hallevadin vehannimtin hakkashin. o habbegadim harakkin beyoter kegon bigde pishtan shel mitzrayim shehabbasar nire mittachtan. enan mekabbelin tuma ad sheyyihye bakkera shelosha al shelosha tefachim ben lemidras ben lishar tumot:

Kol hakkeliot mekabbelot tuma bivgadim. echad hakkolea chutim vaasaan pif o haorgan vaasaan avnet vechayyotze bo. chutz mikkelia sheosin hatztzammarim likshor bah hatztzemer shehi tehora. hakkela shebbet kibbul even shebbah arug o or mekabbelet tuma. nifsak bet etzba shellah tehora. nifsak [bet] happakia shellah bilvad adayin hi betumatah. hammichmorot veharshatot mekabbelin tuma. vehacherem mekabbel tuma mippene zuto. mippene sheene otah hassevacha dakkin beyoter vahare hi keveged. haose beged min hacherem tahor. min zuto mittamme:
Asa chaluk min hammeshammeret im yesh bo shelosha al shelosha mekabbel tuma:
Meshammeret shel yayin shebbalta im meshammeshet meen melacha rishona temea. veim lav tehora:

Mitpechot sefarim hametzuyyarot en mekabbelin tuma mippene sheenan meshammeshin adam shehare tziyyuran meid alehen shebbishvil sefer naasu. vesheenan metzuyyarot mittammeot bishar tumot chutz mittumat midras mippene sheomrin lo amod venaasa melachtenu kemo shebbearnu beinyan mishkav umoshav:
Keset hassabbalim shemmannichin al kitfehen mippene hammot mittammea bemidras umeshammeret shel yayin enah mittammea bemidras:
Beged shechishshev alav letzurot eno mekabbel tuma. bittel machshavto mekabbel tuma. baal habbayit sheasa mitpachot lechappot bahen ketalim o ammudim enam mekabbelot tuma:
Chaluk heasuy kisvacha kede lesachek bo shote shechar eno mekabbel tuma:
Kuppach shennetano al hassefer tahor millekabbel tumat midras. aval mittamme bemet uvishar tumot:

Haose ispelanit ben al haor ben al habbeged af al pi sheyyesh bahen shiur tehorin. asa alehen melugema al habbeged eno mekabbel tuma shehare nitlachlech veeno rauy. veal haor mekabbel tuma mippene shehu mitkanneach verauy lemishkav:
Meematay yekabbel habbeged tuma mishsheyyeerog bo shalosh etzbaot al shalosh etzbaot. vechol hakkelim hanneeragin bemachat kegon hakkis veanpeliya en mekabbelin tuma ad shettiggamer melachtan:
Kol hakkelim hannaasin al gabbe machat kegon metzuda kevan shennaasa bahen bet kibbul melachtan mekabbelin tuma:

Sevacha shemmannichot habbanot berashehen im hitchilu laasot otah mippiha enah mekabbelet tuma ad sheyyiggamer karkaitah. veim hitchila mikkarkaitah enah mekabbelet tuma ad sheyyigmor et piha. ushevisa mekabbelet tuma bifne atzmah. vechuteha chibbur lah letamme ulehittamme:
Sevacha shennikrea im enah mekabbelet rov sear harosh tehora:

Chaluk shel beged o shel leved o shel neyar meematay hu gemar melachto mishsheyyiftach et piv. haggadol lefi gadlo vehakkaton lefi katno. veim nitma hechaluk meematay hu tohorato mishsheyyivle veeno meshammesh meen melachto rishona. nishtayyer bo rubbo millemala adayin hu betumato rubbo millematta tahor. veim nikra mibbet piv tahor:
Haose chagor mitztzavvar shel beged umitztziddo shel sadin eno mekabbel tuma ad sheyyimlol siftotav. asaahu meemtza habbeged umeemtza hassadin eno mekabbel tuma ad sheyyimlol mitztzad hashsheni:
Chagor shebbalu tzedadav veemtzaito kayyemet tame:
Safa sheppersha min habbeged vehitkinah lachagor bah et matnav mekabbelet tuma mippene shehi keavnet:

Tallit shel ani shebbalta im hayu rov siftoteha kayyamot af al pi sheen bah shalosh al shalosh bari hare zo mekabbelet tuma. en siftoteha kayyamot im yesh bah shalosh al shalosh chazak uvari mekabbelet tuma veim lav enah mekabbelet tuma. vechen shear bigde aniyyim:

Matliyyot sheen bahen shelosha al shelosha enan mekabbelot tuma. veim chishshev alehen vehechinan mekabbelot tuma ad sheyyihyu pachot mishshalosh al shalosh. shekkol pachot mishshalosh al shalosh eno mekabbel tuma kelal veaf al pi shehechino:

Pachot mishshelosha al shelosha shehitkino lifkok bo et hammerchatz ulenaer bo et hakkedera ulekanneach bo et harechayim vechayyotze beellu. im hishlicho baashpa eno mekabbel tuma. telao bemagod o hinnicho achore haddelet hare ze kemi shehinnicho betoch begadav vaadayin hu chashuv etzlo umekabbel shear tumot chutz mittumat midras. shehare hu pachot mishshelosha tefachim:

Shelosha al shelosha shehaya mushlach baashpa im haya bari kede litzror bo rova hakkav melach gas velo yikkara hare ze mittamme bemidras veim lav eno mittamme. aval im haya babbayit im haya bari af al pi sheeno yachol litzror bo melach o shehaya tzorer bo melach velo haya bari hare ze tame midras:
Shelosha al shelosha shennikra velo huvdelu hakkeraim im notno al hakkisse uchesheyyeshev alav yigga besaro bakkisse hare ze tahor veim lav hare ze mittamme bemidras:
Shalosh al shalosh shennimcha mimmennu afillu chut echad o shennimtza bah kesher o shene chutin matimin hare zo tehora:

Shalosh al shalosh shehishlichah baashpa tehora. hechezirah mekabbelet tuma. leolam hashelachatah metahartah vehachezaratah metammetah chutz mishshel argaman veshel zehorit tova sheafilu hayta al haashpa mekabbelet tuma mippene shehi chashuva:

Shalosh al shalosh shennetanah bechaddur o sheasaah kaddur bifne atzmah tehora. aval shelosha tefachim al shelosha tefachim shennetano bechaddur hare hu kemot shehaya umittamme bemidras. asahu kaddur bifne atzmo eno mittamme bemidras shehare hattefer memaato mishshelosha al shelosha:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 23:
Hammappatz hu hammachtzelet sheorgin otah min hachavalim umin hassuf umin haggome vechayyotze bahen. veen hammappatz bichlal kelim haamurin battora veaf al pi chen mittamme hu bemidras din tora shehare ribba hakkatuv <small>(Vayikra 15 4)</small> "kol hammishkav" veze rauy lemishkav veasuy lo. vechen mittamme bemet uvishar tumot middivrehen kechol peshute kele etz kemo shebbearnu. veze kelal gadol shekkol hammittamme bemidras mittamme bishar tumot: 
Kevar bearnu shehabbeged mittamme beshalosh al shalosh kemo shebbearnu bishar tumot. uvishlosha tefachim al shelosha tefachim lemidras: 
Hassak shiuro arbaa tefachim al arbaa tefachim. haor chamishsha al chamishsha. hammappatz shishsha al shishsha ben lemidras ben lishar hattumot. ufachot min hashshiurin haellu tehorin mikkelum. bamme devarim amurim bekera echad mehen shennikra belo kavvana. aval hakkotzetz bechavvana vekitztzetz afillu tefach al tefach lemoshav o shelosha tefachim al shelosha tefachim lemishkav hare ze mittamme bemidras. ben shehaya hattefach al tefach shekkitztzetz o hashshelosha beged o sak o or o mappatz. vechen hamekatztzea meechad mehen laachiza kede sheyyochaz bo beyado kederech sheosin kotztze teenim shello yizzoku etzbeotehen hare ze tame bechol shehu. vehu shello yihye pachot mishshalosh al shalosh shekkol pachot mishshalosh etzbaot tahor mikkelum: 
Hamechabber shene tefachim min habbeged umin hassak tefach shelosha min hassak veechad min haor arbaa min haor veechad min hammappatz hare ze tahor min hammidras. aval im chibber chamishsha tefachim min hammappatz veechad min haor arbaa min haor veechad min hassak shelosha min hassak veechad min habbeged hare ze teme midras ze hakkelal kol shehishlim shiuro bechamur mimmennu tame min hakkal tahor: 
Beloye nafa uchevara shehitkinan lishiva tehorin veenan mekabbelin tuma ad sheyyekatztzetzem veachar kach yihyu kemappatz:
