Chaluk shel katan eno mittamme bemidras ad sheyyihye bo keshiur shelosha tefachim al shelosha tefachim venimdad kaful kivriyyato. veellu nimdadin kefulin begadim shemmalbishin otan al haraglayim veal hashshokayim veet harosh vehammichnasayim vehakkova vehakkis shel punda umatlit shettelaah al hassafa im peshuta nimdedet peshuta veim kefula nimdedet kefula: 
Habbeged shearag shelosha al shelosha nitma bemidras veachar kach hishlim et kol habbeged kullo midras. natal chut echad mittechillato tahar min hammidras aval tame magga midras vahare hu rishon kichli shennaga bemidras. natal chut echad mittechillato veachar kach hishlim et kol habbeged kol habbeged tame magga midras. vechen beged shenneerag bo shalosh etzbaot al shalosh etzbaot venitma bemet veachar kach hishlim alav et kol habbeged habbeged kullo teme met. natal chut echad mittechillato tahar mitteme met. aval teme magga teme met. natal chut echad mittechillato veachar kach hishlim et kol habbeged hakkol tahor. velamma yihye hakkol tahor mippene sheamru shalosh al shalosh shennitmaata tehora mikkelum aval shelosha al shelosha shennitmaata af al pi shettahara min hammidras hare hi temea bechol hattumot: 
Matlit shehi midras utelaah al hakkuppa o al haor naasa hakkol rishon letuma. hifrish et hammatlit hare hakkuppa o haor rishon mippene shennagu bammidras vehammatlit tehora shekkevan shettelaah vehifrishah batla. telaah al habbeged o al hassak naasa hakkol midras vahare hakkol av tuma. hifrishah hare habbeged o hassak rishon shehare naga bammidras vehammatlit av tuma keshehayta sheenah betela al haarig. tafar hammatlit al habbeged keshettelaah meruach achat o mishshete ruchot kemin gam eno chibbur velo naasa hakkol av ella magga midras bilvad. tefarah mishshete ruchot zo betzad zo hare hi chibbur venaasa hakkol av: 
Shelosha al shelosha shennitma bemidras veachar kach nechlak tahar min hammidras veen bikraim ellu tuma kelal vehinnam keshivre keli shennitma. aval beged shennitma bemidras vekara mimmennu shalosh etzbaot al shalosh etzbaot oto hakkera tahar min hammidras aval teme magga midras shebbeet perishato min habbeged haggadol nitma bemagga: 
Sadin shennitma bemidras veachar kach asaahu parochet tahar min hammidras. umeematay hu tohorato min hammidras mishsheyyikshor bo hallulaot shehu nitle bahen kishar happarochot: 
Tallit shehi midras vehitbilah vekodem sheyyaariv shimshah hitchil likroa mimmenna kera kevan shennikra bah rubbah shuv enah chibbur vetahara kullah af al pi sheadayin nishtayyer bah kede maaforet shello nikra shehare hu korea veholech. bamme devarim amurim bitvulat yom shekkevan shello chas aleha lehatebilah kach lo yachus likroa et kullah ulefichach tahara kullah:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 24:
Elu orot mittammein bemidras. or shechashav alav lishticha. veor shemmannichin al hammittot millemala lishon alav. veor shemmannichin al hachamor tachat hammassooy. veor shemmannichin baeres tachat hakkatan. veor hakkar. veor hakkeset. veor shemmannichin tachat hashshulchan beet haachila kede sheyyippelu alav happerurin mippene shehu nishan alav beraglo. veor shechoger nofetz happishtan alav beet shennofetz. veor shechoger hachammar alav. veor shemmanniach hassabbal al ketefo beet shessovel. veor shemmanniach harofe al birkav beet shemmefis hashshechinin mippene shekkol haorot haellu yoshev alehen. veor hallev shel katan sheriro yored alav kede shello yippasdu begadav. veor sheasaahu lenotno al libbo bishat hakkatzir mippene hashsharav. veor shelloffin hakkesut bo. veor hattafur beteva shemmannichin bo habbegadim shekkol ellu mithappechin alehen venishanin alehen: 
Kol haorot hammittammeot bemidras enan mittammein ad sheyyihye bahen keshiur chamishsha tefachim al chamishsha tefachim. veellu orot sheen mittammein bemidras. or shechoger sorek hatztzemer beet shessorek. veor shellofef bo hatztzemer hassaruk. veor shellofef bo haargaman. veor hattofer shemmannichin bo haargaman. vechullan mittammein bishar tumot: 
Or sheasao chippuy lechelim tahor mikkelum. asao chippuy lemishkolet mekabbel shear tumot shehare naasa lekabbala veeno mittamme bemidras: 
Or sheasaahu laakevo ulefarsato im chofe et rov haregel mittamme veim lav tahor: 
Minal sheal haimmum af al pi sheadayin lo levasho adam hare ze mittamme bemidras shekkevar nigmera melachto: 
Kol or harauy lehittamme bemidras veeno chaser melacha hammachshava metammeto veim chishshev alav lihyot or shulchan vechayyotze bo hare ze mittamme bemidras. veim chaser melacha en hammachshava moelet bo ad shettiggamer melachto. chutz min haor shemmechappin bo hammerkav mippene haavak shehammachshava moelet bo af al pi shello nigmera melachto. bamme devarim amurim beorot baal habbayit. aval orot haabbedan shessetaman limchira en hammachshava metammetan ad sheyyaase bahen maase vichinem lemidras: 
En adam metamme bemidras mishkav o merkav sheenan shello shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 21)</small> "vehannogea bemishkavo". gazal mishkav vedaras alav belo negia tahor veim nityaashu habbealim tame. ganav mishkav veyashav alav tame shechezkato shennityaashu habbealim sheenan yodim mi genavo veim noda sheadayin lo nityaashu habbealim tahor. lefichach gannav shegganav or vechishshev alav lishchiva machashava moelet lo umittamme bemidras aval haggazlan en machshavto moelet ella im ken nityaashu habbealim: 
Or shennitma bemidras vehitchil lekaro retzuot hare hu betumato ad sheyyemaatennu pachot pachot mechamishsha tefachim: 
Kol keli or shennitma bemidras hazzav veshinnahu lichli acher im shinnahu mippashut lefashut hare hu betumato. shinnahu mippashut limkabbel umimmekabbel lefashut tahor. uveveged hakkol tame. ketzad. chemet sheasaah shatiach veshatiach sheasaah chemet tahor aval chemet shennitmea midras vaasaah turemil o turemil sheasaahu chemet hare hen midras keshehayu: 
Kar shel beged shennitma bemidras vaasaahu sadin o sadin sheasaahu kar o keset. beged sheasaahu mitpachat o mitpachat sheasaahu keset hare hen midras keshehayu: 
Kelim sheikkar asiyyatan lekabbala ulemishkav keechad kegon hakkarim vehakkesatot vehassakkin vehammartztzufin im nifchatu af al pi shettaharu millehittamme bemet uvishar tumot mippene sheenan yecholin lekabbel hare hen mittammein bemidras sheadayin hen reuyin lemidras. aval kelim sheikkar asiyyatan lekabbala bilvad kegon hachemet vehatturemil im hayu gedolim kede sheyyihyu reuyin leshev alehen hoil veyoshvin alehen mippene gadlan hare hen mittammein bemidras kol zeman shehen shelemin nifchatu af al pi sheefshar adayin leshev alehen en mittammein bemidras sheikkar asiyyatan lekabbala bilvad hoil uvatlu millekabbel taharu millehittamme lo bemidras velo bishar tumot. vechamma hu shiuran veyihyu reuyin lemidras hachemet shiva kabbin vehayyalkut chamishsha vehakkelaster shettolin bo hasseorim berosh habbehema arbaa vehakkeritit shemmearin bah hammayim sea. pachot mishshiurin ellu enan reuyin lemidras veen derech haam leshev alehen. nifchatu vetzarar mekom happechat hare hen tehorin ucheillu lo kashar mekom happechat. vechol hachamatot shennifchatu utzeraran tehorot chutz mishshel arviyyim mippene shekkach hu darkan tamid letzarran. vechemet chalilin en mittamme bemidras shehare enah reuya lemidras:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 25: Kol peshute kele etz haasuyin lishiva o lishchiva o lirchiva mittammein bemidras kegon hammitta vehakkisse vechayyotze bahen:

Hammitta vehakkar vehakkeset shel met vechisse shel kalla umashber shel chayya vechisse shel koves shekkoves alav et hakkelim vechisse shel katan sheyyesh lo raglayim af al pi sheen bo gova tefach kol ellu mittammein bemidras:

Kisse shel barzel sheosin bevet hakkisse vehaor natun alav hare hu mittamme bemidras uvishar tumot. hifrish or hamechuppe al habbarzel haor mittamme bemidras vehabbarzel mittamme bishar tumot aval lo bemidras:
Teraskal shel gemi vechayyotze bo hamechuppe beor mittamme bemidras uvishar tumot. hifrish haor mealav haor mittamme bemidras aval hatteraskal tahor mikkelum shehare naasa keshivre kelim:
Safsalin shebbammerchatz sheshshete raglav shel etz mittamme bemidras. hayta achat shel etz veachat shel shayish eno mekabbel tuma:
Nesarim shebbammerchatz sheshshigman enan mekabbelin tuma sheenan asuyin lishiva ella kede sheyyehallechu hammayim tachtehen:
Hakkalkala vehassal shemmillean teven o mochin af al pi shehitkinan lishiva enan mekabbelin tumat midras sheenan reuyin lishiva. veim sergan begemi o bimshicha al pihen mittammein bemidras:

Korat bet habbad sheasa roshah haechad kisse eno mittamme bemidras mippene sheomrin lo amod venaase melachtenu. aval im kava et hakkisse bekorat bet habbad hakkisse mittamme bemidras veim daras hazzav al hakkora lo nitma hakkisse. vechen im kava hakkisse bekora gedola o asa rosh hakkora haggedola kisse en tame ella mekom hakkisse bilvad ushear hakkora tahor. vechen haddin bechisse shekkevao baareva shehu tahor:
Ketzat hakkora shemmetakken hamesattet et haeven leshev alav hare mekom yeshivato mittamme bemidras. umekom yeshiva sheachore hakkaron tahor sheenah ella yeshivat tzaar:

Rashe kelunesot sheyyoshvin alehen haummanin veshafin et haavanim vechayyotze bahen tehorin. vechen kofet shel temara shehu yoshev alav afillu gavoah tefach tahor sheen ze keli. vechen bul shel etz af al pi shesserko vechirkemo vaasaahu panim leshaar vechayyotze bo eno keli velo mekabbel tuma ad sheyyachok bo:

Rashe kelunesot hachakukin im chakakan ledaat mekabbelin tuma. metzaan chakukin im chishshev alehen mekabbelin tuma mikkan ulehabba veim chishshev alehen cheresh shote vekatan o adam sheenan shello tehorin. vechen kol kayyotze bahen middevarim sheenan mekabbelin tuma ella bemachshava sheen lecha machashava moelet ella machashevet bealim shehen bene dea:
Haose kippa min hasseor veyibbeshah veyichadah lishiva hare betela mittorat ochel umittammea bemidras shehare meshammeshet tashmishe haetz:

Machtzelet hakkash mittammea bemidras veshel kanim veshel chelef tehora mippene sheenah reuya lemidras. ushear hammachtzelaot im ashaah lishchiva mekabbelet tuma asaah lesikkuch tehora. asaah setam gedola setamah lesikkuch ketanna setamah lishchiva:

Machtzelet sheasa lah kanim learkah temea midras sheadayin reuya lishchiva. asaah kemin ki tehora. asa lah kanim lerachbah im en ben kane lachavero arbaa tefachim tehora. nechleka lerachbah adayin mekabbelet tuma. learkah nishtayyeru bah shelosha maadannim shel shishsha tefachim adayin hi reuya lemidras umittammea. pachot mikkan tehora. vechen im hittir rashe maadannim tehora. veaf tumat midras lo tekabbel hammachtzelet ad shettiggamer melachtah vetitnakkev kemo shebbearnu:
Teva sheppitchah millemala tehora min hammidras sheenah reuya leshev aleha. umekabbelet shear tumot. pitchah mitztziddah temea bemidras uvishar tumot:
Agala shel katan mittammea bemidras shehare nishan aleha:
Makkel shel zekenim tahor mikkelum sheeno ella lesayyea:
Sandal shel sayyadin vehu sandal shel etz mittamme bemidras mippene shehassayyad peamim metayyel bo ad shemmaggia leveto:
Kav shel kittea sheyyesh bo bet kibbul ketitin mittamme bishar tumot mippene bet kibbulo. umittamme bemidras shehare nishan alav:

Veellu temein mishshum merkav. mirdaat shel chamor. vetappitan shel sus. vechar haggamal. veukkaf shel naka vechol kayyotze bahen. halluchot shemmannichin al gabbe hachamor veachar kach notnin alav hammassooy tehorot veim hayta reuya lemerkav temea:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 26:
Keli etz harauy lemidras shekkevao bechotel betoch habbinyan. kevao bakkotel velo bana al gabbav o bana al gabbav velo kevao adayin mittamme bemidras keshehaya. kevao bemasmerim uvana alav tahor. vechen mappatz shennetano al gabbe hakkorot kevao velo natan alav et hammaaziva o shennatan alav et hammaaziva velo kevao mittamme bemidras. kevao venatan alav et hammaaziva tahor: 
Safsal shennittal echad merashav adayin hu rauy lemidras. nittal hashsheni tahor. veim yesh bo gova tefach mittamme bemidras: 
Kisse shel kalla shennittelu chippuyav tahor veim lo hayu chippuyav yotzim venittelu adayin hu rauy lemidras shekken darko lihyot mattehu al tziddo veyoshev alav: 
Kisse shennittelu chippuyav vaadayin hu rauy lishiva mittamme. nittelu shenayim mechippuyav ze betzad ze tahor: 
Shidda shennittal haelyon shellah temea mippene hattachton shehu rauy lemidras. nittal hattachton temea mippene haelyon. nittelu shetehen hare haddappin tehorin: 
Teva shennifchata mitztziddah mittammea bemidras uvishar tumot mippene sheruya af lishiva vehakkol yoshvin aleha. nifchata millemala tehora min hammidras shehare enah reuya lishiva umittammea bishar tumot sheadayin hi mekabbelet. nifchata millematta tehora mikkol tumot af al pi sheefshar leshev aleha bechisse mippene sheikkar maaseha lekabbala uchevar batal haikkar. vehammegurot shellah mittammeot veenan chibbur lah. vechen mashpelet shennifchata millekabbel rimmonim af al pi sheruya lemidras hare hi tehora mikkelum mippene sheikkar maaseha lekabbala vehoil uvatal haikkar batla hattefela: 
Areva shel etz shemmegabbelin bah habbinyan o et haggefasim af al pi shemmekabbelet shear tumot enah mittammea bemidras. veshellashin bah et habbatzek shemmechazzeket mishshene login vead tisha kabbin shennisdeka ad sheeno yachol lirchotz bah raglo achat mippene hassedek hare zo mittammea bemidras shessetamah shekkoftah veyoshev aleha lefi gadlah vesedek shellah. hinnichah baggeshamim ad shennitpecha venistam hassedek enah mittammea bemidras shehare hi reuya lalush bah utechillat maaseha lalush bah umekabbelet shear tumot. chazar vehinnichah bakkadim veniftach hassedek chazra lekabbel tumat midras utehora mishshear tumot: 
Areva gedola shehi yeter al tisha kabbin shennifchata millekabbel rimmonim vehechinah lishiva hare zo tehora af mittumat midras ad sheyyaktzia sheen hammachshava moelet baareva gedola shennifchata ad sheyyaase bah maase. asaah evus livhema af al pi shekkevaah bakkotel temea bechol hattumot: 
Mitta shennittelu shete arukkot shellah achar shennitmet veasa lah arukkot chadashot velo shinna et hannekavim venishberu hachadashot adayin hi betumatah. nishtabberu hayeshanot tehora shehakkol holech achar hayeshanot: 
Mitta shehayta temea midras venittela ketzara ushete keraayim adayin hi betumatah sheadayin tzurat hammitta omedet. nittela arukka ushete keraayim tehora: 
Kitztzetz shete leshonot shel mitta baalachson o shekkitztzetz shete keraayim tefach al tefach baalachson o shemmiatan pachot mittefach hare zo nishbera utehora. nishbera arukka vetikkenah adayin hi av tuma keshehayta. nishbera haarukka hashsheniyya vetikkenah tehora min hammidras aval temea magga midras. lo hispik letakken et harishona ad shennishbera hashsheniyya tehora: 
Mitta shehayta temea midras o bishar tumot venignav chetzyah o avad chetzyah o shechillekuha achin o shuttafin hare zo tehora shehare ze kichli shennishbar. hechziruha mekabbelet tuma mikkan ulehabba. hare ze dome lemi sheasa keli echad mishshivre kelim shennitma shehu tahor umekabbel tuma lehabba: 
Mitta shennifreku evareha im nishbera arukka ushete keraayim o ketzara ushete keraayim hare ellu mittammein mippene sheruyin lesamchan bakkotel velishon alehen: 
Mitta shennitmet kullah im hitbilah evarim evarim tehora: 
Hamefarek et hammitta lehatebilah hannogea bachavalim shellah tahor:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 27:
Shalosh tevot hen. teva shennifchata mitztziddah temea midras. millemala temea teme met. vehabbaa bemidda tehora mikkelum: 
Shalosh arevot hen. areva mishshene login vead tisha kabbin shennisdeka temea midras. shelema temea teme met. vehabbaa bemidda tehora mikkelum: 
Shalosh agalot hen. haasuya kekatedra temea midras. kemitta temea teme met. veshel avanim tehora mikkelum: 
Shelosha terisin hen. teris hakkafuf tame midras. veshemmesachakin bo bekumpon tame teme met. veditzat haarviyyim tehora mikkelum. lefi shehi asuya letzura bilvad veenah mimmeshammeshe adam vechol keli sheeno mimmeshammeshe adam eno mekabbel tuma kol ikker: 
Shelosha tarbusin shel or hen. shel sefarim tame midras. vesheochlin alav tame teme met. vesheshshotchim alav et hazzetim tahor mikkelum lefi sheeno mimmeshammeshe adam: 
Shelosha besisaot hen. shellifne hammitta veshellifne hassofrim tame midras. shel shulchan tame teme met. veshel migdal tahor mikkelum lefi shehu miktzat migdal vetzurato mochachat alav: 
Shalosh mittot hen. haasuya lishchiva temea midras. veshel zaggagim shennotnin bah kele zechuchit temea tumat met. veshel saragin shemmesargin aleha et hassevachot tehora mikkelum lefi sheenah mimmeshammeshe adam: 
Shalosh mishpalot hen. shel zevel temea midras. shel teven temea teme met. vehappuchlatz shel gemallim tahor mikkelum lefi shehachavalim shello kashim beyoter veavim veeno rauy lekabbel teven vechayyotze bo venimtza sheen alav torat kele ella chavalim bilvad: 
Shelosha mappatzin hen. heasuy lishiva tame midras. veshel tzabbaim shemmannichin bo et hakkelim tame teme met. veshel gittot shennotnin alav anavim umechappin bo tahor mikkelum lefi sheeno mimmeshammeshe adam: 
Shalosh chamatot hen ushelosha turemlin hen. hamekabbelin keshiur temein midras. vechamma shiuran hachemet arbaa kabbin vehatturemil chamishsha. vesheenan mekabbelin keshiur temeim teme met. veshel orot haddag tahor mikkelum: 
Shelosha orot hen. heasuy leshatiach teme midras. veheasuy letachrich kelim tame teme met. veshel retzuot veshel sandalin tahor mikkelum lefi sheen alav tzurat keli: 
Shelosha sedinin hen. heasuy lishchiva tame midras. veheasuy lefarochet tame teme met. veshel tzurot sheosin oto kede sheyyitlammed mimmennu harokem tahor mikkelum lefi sheeno mimmeshammeshe adam: 
Shalosh mitpachot hen. shel yadayim temea midras. veshel sefarim temea teme met. veshel tachriche hammet veshel nivle bene levi tehora mikkelum lefi sheenan mimmeshammeshe adam: 
Or heasuy kemo yad shemmachnisin bo hayyad vehaetzbaot mippene hatztzinna vechayyotze bahen hu hannikra peraklinin. ushelosha peraklinin hen. shel tzayyade chayya veof tame midras shehare nishan alav. veshel chagavim tame teme met shennotnin bo hachagavim. veshel kayaytzim shebbo mekayyetzin perot tahor mikkelum lefi sheeno mimmeshammeshe adam: 
Shalosh sevachot hen. shel yalda temea midras. veshel zekena temea teme met. vesheosin lesachek bah leshote shechar tehora mikkelum lefi sheenah mimmeshammeshe adam: 
Shelosha sandalin hen. shel adam tame midras. shel mattachot shel behema tame teme met. shel shaam veshel tzefira tehora mikkelum. kelalo shel davar kol keli sheeno rauy lemishkav o lemerkav o shehu rauy velo naasa [lechach] ella limlacha acheret hare hu tahor min hammidras. naasa limlacha acheret umeshammesh immah et hayeshiva kegon hattallit vehardid mittamme bemidras. vechol hammittamme bemidras mittamme bemet veyesh mittamme bemet veeno mittamme bemidras kemo shebbearnu. vechol hammittamme bemet mittamme bishar avot hattumot ben avot shel tora ben shel divrehem umittammein bemashkin: 
Shalosh kuppot hen. mehuha shettelaah al habberia holchin achar habberia. ketanna al haggedola holchin achar haggedola. hayu shavot holchin achar happenimit. ketzad holchin achareha. sheim nikkeva bemotzi rimmon shetehen tehorot: 
Shelosha pinkasot hen. haappifyorin shemmannichin alav hassefarim teme midras. vesheyyesh bo bet kibbul shaava tame teme met. chillekah tehora mikkelum lefi sheen alav tzurat keli veeno rauy lemidras:
Mishneh Torah, Vessels 28:
Kol hakkelim sheyyesh lahen bet kibbul shennitmeu achorehen bemashkin lo nitma tochan litruma velo agnehen velo aznehen velo mekom etzba hashshokea bisfat hakkeli. nitma toch hakkeli nitmeu kullan. naflu mashkin temein al kanne hakkelim o al agnehen o al aznehen o al yedot hakkelim hamekabbelin hare ze menaggevan vehen tehorin vaafillu achore hakkeli kullo lo nitmeu: 
Echad kele hassak kegon hassakkin vehammartztzufin. o kele haor kegon hakkarim vehakkesatot. veechad kele etz afillu kuppot umishpalot im nitmeu achorehen bemashkin lo nitma tochan: 
Peshute kele shetef sheen reuyin lemidras kegon hashshulchan vetavla sheen lah dofen hoil veen mekabbelin tuma min hattora im nitmeu achorehen bemashkin lo nitma tochan. aval peshute kele shetef haruyim lemidras kegon hammitta vehaor sheyyeshenim alav vehakkisse vechayyotze bahen en lahem achorayim vetoch ella ben shennagu mashkin bahen mittochan o meachorehen nitma hakkeli kullo. vechen middot yayin veshemen vezoma listerot umesannenet shel chardal umeshammeret shel yayin en lahen achorayim vetoch ella im nafal mashkin al miktzatan nitmeu kullan kemo habbegadim: 
Hammardea vehammalmad yesh lahen achorayim vetoch. ketzad. naflu mashkin al hacharchur lo nitma min haetz hassamuch lacharchur ella shiva tefachim bilvad ushear haetz tahor. vechen im naflu mashkin al haddarvan lo nitma ella arbaa tefachim hassemuchin laddarvan. naflu chutz leshiva vechutz learbaa hare ze kichli kibbul shennagu mashkin baachorav velo nitmeu ella mimmekom maggao velachutz: 
Kis shebbetoch kis shennitma echad mehen bemashkin lo nitma chavero. bamme devarim amurim keshehayu siftotehen shavin. aval im haya hachitzon odef venitma happenimi. nitma hachitzon nitma hachitzon lo nitma happenimi uvesheretz ben kach uven kach im nitma echad mehem lo nitma chavero: 
Hachokek rova vachatzi rova beetz echad venitma echad mehen bemashkin lo nitma hashsheni af al pi shehen etz echad. ketzad. nagu mashkin temein betoch harova harova vaachorav temein vachatzi harova vaachorav tehorin. nagu bachatzi harova mittocho chatzi harova vaachorav temeim harova vaachorav tehorin. ucheshehu matbil matbil et hakkol. nitmeu achore harova o achore chatzi harova bemashkin hare achore hakkeli tame sheen cholkin et haachorayim: 
Kumekumos shehayu achorav temein vehaya martiach en choshshin shemma yatzu mashkin mittocho venagu baachorav vechazru letocho ella hare hammashkin shebbetocho tehorin litruma: berich rachamana desayyean
Mishneh Torah, Immersion Pools 1: Kol hattemein ben adam ben kelim ben shennitmeu tuma chamura shel tora ben shennitmeu betuma shel divrehen en lahen tohora ella bitvila bemayim hannikvin bekarka:

Kol makom shenneemar battora rechitzat basar vechibbus begadim min hattuma eno ella tevilat kol hagguf bemikve. veze shenneemar bezav <small>(Vayikra 15 11)</small> "veyadav lo shataf bammayim" kelomar sheyyitbol kol gufo. vehu haddin lishar hattemein sheim taval kullo chutz merosh etzba hakketanna adayin hu betumato. vechol haddevarim haelle af al pi shehen mippi hashshemua hare neemar <small>(Vayikra 11 32)</small> "bammayim yuva vetame ad haerev vetaher" binyan av lechol hattemeim sheyyavou bammayim:

Kol hakkelim shennitmeu yesh lahen tohora bemikve chutz mikkele cheres uchele zechuchit vechen hammappatz. keli cheres neemar bo <small>(Vayikra 11 33)</small> "veoto tishboru "veen lo tohora ella shevira. afillu chibbero bekarka vaafillu kevao bemasmer vaafillu milleahu sid o gefasim hare hu kemo shehaya ad sheyyishshaver. uchele zechuchit kichle cheres asaum bedavar ze:

Hammappatz eno bichlal hakkelim hamekabbelim shear kol hattumot lefi sheeno keli kibbul eno mikkelal kele etz haamurin battora vehoil vehu rauy lemishkav nitrabba letumat midras bilvad din tora. vechevan sheen lo tuma vetahara beferush venitrabba lattuma lo yitrabbe letaher bemikve sheen mittaher bemikve ella hakkelim haamurin battora veen lammappatz tohora ella keriato ad sheyyishshaer pachot mishshishsha al shishsha tefachim:
Hazzav en lo tohora ella bemayan shehare neemar bo <small>(Vayikra 15 13)</small> "bemayim chayyim" aval hazzava ushear hattemein ben adam ben kelim tovlin af bemikve:

Kol chayyave tevilot tevilatan bayyom chutz minnidda veyoledet shettevilatan ballayla kemo shebbearnu beinyan nidda. uvaal keri tovel veholech kol hayyom kullo mittechillat hallayla shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 12)</small> "vehaya lifnot erev yirchatz bammayim" melammed shettovel veholech mittechillat hallayla ad haarev shemesh:

Kol hattovel tzarich sheyyitbol kol gufo keshehu arum bevat achat. veim haya baal sear yatbil kol sear rosho vahare hu kegufo din tora. vechol hattemein shettavlu bevigdehen alta lahen tevila mippene shehammayim bain bahen veenan chotztzin. vechen hannidda shettavla bivgadeha mutteret levaalah:

Kol hattovel tzarich lehitkavven litvila veim lo nitkavven alta lo tevila lechullin. afillu nidda shettavla belo kavvana kegon shennafla letoch hammayim o yarda lehaker hare zo mutteret levaalah. aval litruma ulekadashim enah tehora ad shettitbol bechavvana:

Hakkofet yadav veraglav veyashav lo beammat hammayim im nichnesu mayim derech kullo tahor. hakkofetz letoch hammikve hare ze megunne. vehattovel paamayim bammikve hare ze megunne. vehaomer lachavero kevosh yadcha alay bammikve hare ze megunne:

Bet hassetarim uvet hakkematim enan tzerichin sheyyavou bahen hammayim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 11)</small> "veyadav lo shataf bammayim" evarim hannirim bilvad. veaf al pi chen tzerichin lihyot reuyin sheyyavou bahen hammayim velo yihye davar chotzetz lefichach amru chachamim leolam yilmod adam betoch beto shettihye ishsha medicha ben kemateha bemayim veachar kach titbol. vehaishsha tovelet kederech gedilatah keoreget uchemenika et benah:

Ishsha enah tovelet bannamel mippene shemmitbayyeshet mibbene hair veenah tovelet kahogen. veim hikkif lah mappatz vechayyotze bo kede lehatzeniah tovelet bannamel. velo titbol al gabbe keli cheres o sal vechayyotze bahen mippene shemmefachedet velo taale lah tevila:

Echad haadam o hakkelim lo yihye davar chotzetz benam uven hammayim. veim haya davar chotzetz benam uven hammayim kegon shehaya batzek o tit mudbak al besar haadam o al guf hakkeli hare ze tame keshehaya velo alta lahen tevila. devar tora im haya davar hachotzetz chofe et rov haadam o rov hakkeli lo alta lahen tevila vehu sheyyakpid alav verotze lehaaviro. aval im eno makpid alav velo sam oto al lev ben avar ben lo avar eno chotzetz veaf al pi shechofe et rubbo. vechen im haya chofe miuto eno chotzetz af al pi shehu makpid alav. middivre sofrim shekkol davar hachotzetz im haya makpid alav lo alta lo tevila af al pi shehu al miuto gezera mishshum rubbo. vechol davar hachotzetz im haya chofe et rubbo lo alta lo tevila af al pi sheeno makpid alav gezera mishshum rubbo hammakpid alav. nimtzeta omer sheim haya al besar haadam o al guf hakkeli davar middevarim hachotztzin kegon batzek vezefet vechayyotze bahen afillu tippa kechardal vehu makpid alav lo alta lo tevila. veim eno makpid alav alta lo tevila. ella im ken haya chofe rov hakkeli o rov haadam kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Immersion Pools 2: Elu chotztzin baadam. lifluf shechutz laayin. vegeled shechutz lammakka. vehaddam yavesh sheal gabbe hammakka. vehartiyya shealeha. vegilde tzoa sheal besaro. uvatzek o tit shettachat hatztzipporen. vehammilmulin sheal hagguf. vetit hayyaven vetit hayyotzrim vetit shel derachim hannimtza sham tamid afillu bimot hachamma kol ellu chotztzin. ushear kol hattit keshehu lach eno chotzetz shehare nimcha bemayim ucheshehu yavesh chotzetz:

Haddevash. vehaddeyo. vehechalav. vehaddam. useraf hattut. vehatteena. vehashshikma. vehecharuv. yeveshin chotztzin lachin enan chotztzin. ushear kol hasserafin ben lachin ben yeveshin chotztzin. vedam shennisrach babbasar afillu lach chotzetz. haever vehabbasar hameduldalim chotztzin:
Bet hassetarim beishsha chotzetz ad shettadiach techilla. shehazzea sham tamid veheavak mitkabbetz vechotzetz. bamme devarim amurim binsua. aval bifnuya hoil veenah makpedet eno chotzetz:
Haeged sheal gabbe hammakka. vehakkaskassin sheal gabbe hashshever. vehashsherim vehannezamim vehakkatlayot vehattabbaot. bizman shehen chazakim udevukim babbasar chotztzim. rafim enam chotztzin:

Chute tzemer vechute pishtan vehartzuot shekkoshrot hannashim berashehen lenoy chotztzin mippene shemmavdilin ben hagguf uven hammayim. aval chute sear en chotztzin mippene shehammayim bain bahen af al pi sheenan rafin:

Chutin shebbatztzavvar enan chotztzin afillu shel pishtan lefi sheen ishsha choneket atzmah bahen. aval chavakim shebbatztzavvar kegon katlayot vaanakim chotztzin lefi shehaishsha choneket atzmah bahen kede shetterae baalat basar:
Sear sheal hallev shennitkashsher venaasa kilkin. vechen kilke hazzakan chotztzin:

Chetz hattachuv beadam bizman shehu nire chotzetz. uvazzeman sheeno nire tovel veochel bitrumato laerev af al pi shehu chetz tame. vechen mi shebbala tabbaat tame vetaval hare ze tahor. veim hekiah achar shettaval nitma bemaggaah shekkevar bearnu shekkol habbeluim beguf hachay lo metammein velo mittammein. nichnesu tzerorot vekesamin besidke raglav millematta chotztzin:

Ispelanit melugema uretiyya sheal bet hassetarim chotztzin. af al pi sheeno tzarich sheyyikkansu bahen hammayim tzerichin sheyyihyu reuyin velo yehe bahen davar chotzetz kemo shebbearnu. hayta bo seara achat o shetayim chutz lammakka veroshah mudbak lammakka o shehayu shete searot rosham mudbak betit o betzoa o shehayu shete searot berise enav millematta unekavan vehotzian berise enav millemala hare ellu chotztzin:
Lo yitbol adam beafar sheal raglav veim taval eno chotzetz:
Haochez beadam uvechelim vehitbilan hare hen betumatan. veaf al pi sherippa yadav ad shebbau bahen hammayim gezera shemma lo yarpe. veim hediach yadav bammayim alta lahen tevila:
Hammafshelet benah laachorah vetavla lo alta lah tevila shemma haya tit beragle hattinok o beyadav venidbak beimmo bishat tevila vechatzatz veachar shealta nafal:

Nidda shennatna searah befiha o shekkaftza yadah o shekkartza besiftoteha o shennimtza etzem ben shinneha keillu lo tavla. vechen shear kol hattemeim. natna maot befiha veyarda vetavla tahara mittumat hannidda vahare hi temea al gav rukka venimtzet rishon letuma kemi shennaga berok hannidda. vechen haddin bezav:

Veellu sheen chotztzin beadam. kilke harosh uvet hashshechi uvet hassetarim shebbaish. velifluf shebbaayin. vegeled sheheelta hammakka. velichluche tzoa sheal besaro. vetzoa shettachat hatztzipporen. vetzipporen hameduldelet. ucheshut hakkatan vehu hassear haddak sheal besaro. kol ellu enan chotztzin:

Shete searot o yeter shehayu keshurin keachat kesher echad enan chotztzin mippene shehammayim bain bahen. useara achat shennikshera chotzetzet vehu sheyyihye makpid aleha. aval im eno makpid aleha alta lo tevila ad shettihye rov searo kashur nima nima bifne atzmo kaze horu haggeonim. veyerae li shessearo shel adam kegufo hu chashuv leinyan tevila veeno keguf bifne atzmo kede shennomar rov hassear ella af al pi shekkol sear rosho kashur nima nima im eno makpid alav alta lo tevila ella im ken nitztaref lechotzetz acher al gufo venimtza hakkol rov gufo kemo shebbearnu. veechad hannidda veechad shear hattemein sheyyesh beroshan sear:

Takkanat ezra hi shettihye ishsha chofefet et searah veachar kach titbol. veim efshar lah lachof ballayla velitbol miyyad techef lachafifa hare ze meshubbach. uvishat haddechak o mippene hacholi chofefet afillu beerev shabbat vetovelet lemotzae shabbat:
Tavla vealta venimtza aleha davar chotzetz im beoto hayyom shechaffa tavla enah tzericha lachof paam sheniyya ella chozeret vetovelet miyyad bilvad. veim lav tzericha lachof paam sheniyya velitbol:

Lo tachof ishsha beneter mippene shemmekattef et hassear. velo beohel mippene shemmasrich et hassear. ella bechammin vaafillu bechamme chamma mippene shehachammin meyashsherin et hassear umesalselin oto. aval hatztzonnin mekalkelin umekabbetzin et hassear umitkashsher:
Nidda shennatna tavshil livnah vetavla lo alta lah tevila mippene hashshamnunit sheal yadeha:

Sarta bivsarah vehotzi dam vetavla. betoch shelosha yamim en mekom hasseritot chotzetz leachar shelosha yamim chotzetz mippene shehaddam nikpe sham kegeled sheal gabbe hammakka. vechen lifluf shebbaayin im haya yavesh vehu shehitchil lehorik chotzetz benidda:
Kochal shebbaayin eno chotzetz. sheal gav haayin chotzetz. veim hayu eneha porchot af al gabbe haayin eno chotzetz:

Patcha eneha beyoter o itztzamtan beyoter lo alta lah tevila. bamme devarim amurim leinyan tohorot. aval lehattirah levaalah hare zo mutteret. af al pi shennatna tavshil livnah o shehaya bah seret yashan o shehaya al gav enah kochal. uven patcha eneha o itztzamtan hare zo mutteret levaalah shekkol haddevarim haellu vechayyotze bahen enan chotztzin ella middivrehen uleinyan tohorot gazru leinyan bia lo gazru. vechol hachotzetz benidda letohorot chotzetz bishar hattemein leinyan tohorot. vechotzetz beger bishat tevila:

Mi shettaval veala venimtza alav davar chotzetz af al pi shennitassek beoto hammin kol hayyom kullo hare hu betumato ad sheyyomar yodea ani bevadday shello haya ze alay kodem hattevila hoil vehuchzak tame haamed tame al tumato ad shetteda bevadday shettahar:
Mishneh Torah, Immersion Pools 3:
Veelu chotztzin bechelim. hazzefet vehachemar vechayyotze bahen. hazzefet shebbakkos veshebbatztzelochit mittochan chotztzin meachorehen enan chotztzin. bamme devarim amurim mibbet haumman. aval mibbaal habbayit ben mittochan ben meachorehen chotztzin. hazzefet shebbattamchuy veshebbakkeara ben mittochan ben meachorehen ben mibbaal habbayit ben mibbet haumman chotztzin: 
Hammor vehakkomos ben bechos ben bitzlochit ben betamchuy ukeara ben mibbaal habbayit ben mibbet haumman ben mittochan ben meachorehen chotztzin. haya zefet o chemar vechayyotze bahen al hattavla veal hashshulchan veal haddargash im hayu nekiyyim chotztzin mippene shemmakpid alehen. veal habbelusin enan chotztzin mippene sheeno makpid alehen: 
Hayu al mittot baal habbayit chotztzin al mittot shel ani enan chotztzin. al ukkaf baal habbayit chotzetz veal zakkakin eno chotzetz. al hammirdaat mishshene tzedadin chotzetz: 
Hayu zefet o chemar vechayyotze bahen al bigde talmide chachamim afillu mitztzad echad chotzetz mippene shemmakpidin al malbushan lihyot naki. al bigde amme haaretz mishshene tzedadin chotzetz mitztzad echad eno chotzetz: 
Hayu al hammitpachot shel zappatim veshel yotzrim veshel mefassele ilanot enan chotztzin: 
Tabbach shehaya dam al begadav eno chotzetz mippene sheeno makpid: 
Mocher revav shehaya revav al bigdo eno chotzetz. vechen kol kayyotze baze. haya hattabbach mocher revav vehaya al bigdo dam urevav hare ze safek im chotzetz mippene shehen shenayim umakpid o eno chotzetz shehare melachto hi veeno makpid: 
Haya hazzefet o hachemar vechayyotze bahen al hassandal mittocho. millemala chotzetz millematta eno chotzetz. al hassafsal millemala o min hatztzedadin chotzetz millematta eno chotzetz: 
Lichluche tzoa shebbakkisse veshebbakkattedra hamechubbashin ben mittochan ben meachorehen ben millematta ben min hatztzedadin enan chotztzin mippene shehammayim maavirin otan. aval lichluche shemarim shebbakkos veshebbatztzelochit vehammoch shebbashsher veshebbazzog. vehattit vehabbatzek sheal yad hakkordom vesheal yad hammagrefa [enan chotztzin. higlidu] chotztzin: 
Davar barur hu shekkol makom sheamarnu bezefet uvechemar vechayyotze bahen sheenan chotztzin bechelim mippene sheeno makpid hu lefichach im haya rov hakkeli chafuy bezefet o bechemar vechayyotze bahen lo alta lo tevila kemo shebbearnu af al pi sheeno makpid. en bedavar ze hefresh bichli min hakkelim ella kol hakkelim shavin bedavar ze: 
Kol yedot hakkelim shehen chalulin shehichnisan shello kedarkan. o shehichnisan kedarkan velo merkan. o shehayu shel mattechet venishberu. lo alta lahen tevila: 
Keli shehafach piv lematta vehitbilo keillu lo taval mippene sheen hammayim nichnasin bechullo. haya bo makom sheen hammayim nichnasin bo ad sheyyattennu al tziddo lo alta lo tevila ad sheyyattennu al tziddo: 
Keli shehu tzar mikkan umikkan verachav baemtza eno tahor ad sheyyattennu al tziddo: 
Tzelochit sheppiha shokea enah tehora ad sheyyattenna al tziddah: 
Kalmarin enah tehora ad sheyyikkavenna mitztziddah kede sheyyikkansu hammayim laakmumiyyut shebbah: 
Behema shehaya hashsher shealeha rafuy venitma matbilin oto bimkomo: 
Lo yatbil adam et hakkumkum befechamin shebbo ella im ken shifshef: 
Keli shehu male mashkin vehitbilo keillu lo taval. haya male mayim vehitbilo hare hammayim vehakkeli tehorin keachat mippene shehammayim yesh lahen tohora bemikve kemo shebbearnu betumat ochalin umashkin. haya hakkeli male me raglayim roin oto keillu hu mayim. haya bo me chattat im haya rov hakkeli panuy kede sheyyirbu me mikve al me chattat shebbetocho hare ze tahor. veim lav adayin hu betumato ucheillu hen shear mashkin shechotztzin ben guf hakkeli uven me hammikve: 
Keli shettocho tahor vegabbo tame vehaya male yayin lavan o chalav vehitbilo. holchin achar harov im haya rov hakkeli panuy kede sheyyirbu hammayim betocho tahor mippene shettumato middivrehen. aval im haya bo yayin adom o shear mashkin lo alta lo tevila: 
Lagin shehu male mayim temein vehaya al piv tit tofeach vehaya hattit shokea bammayim vehitbilo tahor. veim haya tit hayyavin vechayyotze bo keillu lo taval. vechen tabbaat shennetanah bilvena shel tit tofeach vehitbilah tehora. veim haya tit yaven keillu lo tevalah: 
Ellu sheen tzerichin sheyyavou hammayim bahen. setam kishre bigde aniyyim, veim hikpid alehen chotztzin. vekishre bigde baale battim setaman chotztzin, veim eno makpid alehen enan chotztzin. vekishre nime habbegadim shenniksheru mealehen. vechevet hassandal. utefilla shel rosh bizman shehakketzitza devuka im hartzua shebbah vachazaka. utefilla shel zeroa bizman sheenah ola veyoredet. veazne hachemet vehatturemil. vechol kayyotze beellu mikkesharim utefarim sheeno atid lehattiram: 
Veellu shetztzerichin sheyyavou bahen hammayim. hakkesharim shebbefitche hechaluk shehen asuyin lulaot. vechen kishre lulaot shebbakkatef. vesafa shel sadin tzarich lematteach. utefilla shel rosh bizman sheenah kevua birtzua. veshel zeroa bizman shehi ola veyoredet. ushenatzim shel sandal. vekishre nime habbegadim shekkesharan. vechen kol kayyotze beellu hammekomot shehu atid legallotan ulematchan. hassallin shel gat veshel bad im hayu chazakim tzarich lechattet veim hayu rafim tzarich lenaer. hakkar vehakkeset shel or tzerichim sheyyavou bahen hammayim: 
Keset agulla. vehakkaddur. vehaimmum. vehakkamea. vehattefilla. enan tzerichin sheyyavou hammayim lachalalan. ze hakkelal kol sheen darko lehotzi ulehachnis tovel satum: 
Hammatbil begadim hamechubbasin tzerichin sheyyikkansu bahen hammayim ad sheyyevabeu. hitbilan neguvin ad sheyyevabeu veyanuchu mibbiabbuan: 
Kol yedot hakkelim shehen arukkim yoter mikkede tzarkan veatid lekatztzan matbilan ad mekom hammidda. ketzad. shalshelet deli gadol arbaa tefachim vekatan asara. matbil min hashshalshelet ad midda zo bilvad vehashshear tahor: 
Keli tame shennatan betocho kelim acherim vehitbil hakkol alta lahen tevila af al pi sheppi hakkeli tzar beyoter shehare hammayim nichnasin lo umittoch shealta tevila lakkeli haggadol alta tevila lakkelim shebbetocho. veim hittahu al tziddo vehitbil lo alta lahen tevila ad sheyyihye piv rachav kishfoferet hannod. vechen im haya hakkeli tahor venatan letocho kelim temeim vehitbilan lo alta lahen tevila ad sheyyihye piv rachav kishfoferet hannod. bamme devarim amurim litruma. aval lekodesh en matbilin kelim letoch kelim tehorin kelal vaafillu hayu besal o bekuppa kemo shebbearnu lemala bimkomo:
Mishneh Torah, Immersion Pools 4:
Din tora shekkol mayim mechunnasin tovlin bahen shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 36)</small> "mikve mayim" mikkol makom. vehu sheyyihye bahen kede lehaalot bahen kede tevila lechol guf haadam bevat achat. shiaru chachamim amma al amma berum shalosh ammot. veshiur ze hu machazik arbaim sea mayim ben sheuvin ben sheenan sheuvin: 
Middivre sofrim shehammayim hashsheuvin pesulin litvila. velo od ella mikve mayim sheenan sheuvin shennafal letochan shelosha login mayim sheuvin paslu hakkol. af al pi sheppissul mayim sheuvin middivre sofrim lemaduhu behekkesh shehare hu omer <small>(Vayikra 11 36)</small> "ach mayan uvor mikve mayim yihye tahor", hammayan en bo tefisat yad adam kelal vehabbor kullo bide adam shehare kullo mayim sheuvin, amru chachamim hammikve lo yihye kullo shauv kevor veen tzarich lihyot kullo bide shamayim kemayan ella im yesh bo tefisat yad adam kasher: 
Ketzad. hammanniach kankannim berosh haggag lenaggevam veyardu lahem geshamim venitmalleu af al pi shehi onat haggeshamim hare ze yishbor et hakkankannim o yichpem vehammayim hannikvim mehem kesherim litbol veaf al pi shekkol hammayim haellu hayu bakkelim shehare lo millean beyado. lefichach im higbiah et hakkankannim veheeram hare kol hammayim shebbahem sheuvin: 
Hammanniach kelim tachat hatztzinnor tamid bechol et uvechol zeman echad kelim ketannim veechad kelim gedolim afillu kele avanim vechayyotze bahen mikkelim sheenan mekabbelin tuma venitmalleu me geshamim hare ellu pesulin. veim kefaan al pihen o shevaran hammayim hannikvin mehen kishuvin lechol davar shehare ledato nitmalleu shechezkat hatztzinnor lekalleach mayim. vaafillu shachach hakkelim tachat hatztzinnor pesulin gazru al hashshocheach mippene hammanniach. vechen hammanniach et hakkelim bechatzer beet kishshur heavim venitmalleu hammayim shebbahen pesulin shehare ledato nitmalleu. vechen gazru al hashshocheach bechatzer bishat kishshur avim mishshum manniach. hinnichan bechatzer beet pizzur avim uvau avim venitmalleu hare ellu kesherin kemo shemmannichan berosh haggag lenaggevan. vechen im hinnichan beet kishshur heavim venitpazzeru vechazru venitkashsheru venitmalleu hare ellu kesherin. veim shibberan o kefaan hammayim hannikvin mehen kesherin: 
Hassayyad sheshshachach atzitz bammikve venitmalleu mayim af al pi shello nishar bammikve ella meat vahare heatzitz yesh bo rov hammikve hare ze yishbor et heatzitz bimkomo venimtza hammikve kullo kasher. vechen hamesadder et hakkankannim betoch hammikve kede lechasseman venitmalleu mayim af al pi shebbala hammikve et memav velo nishar sham mayim kelal ella mayim shebbetoch hakkankannim hare ze yishbor et hakkankannim vehammayim hannikvin mehen mikve kasher: 
Ketzad poslin hammayim hashsheuvin et hammikve bishlosha login. sheim haya bammikve pachot mearbaim sea [venafal letochan shelosha login vehishlimum learbaim sea] hakkol pasul. aval mikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea mayim sheenan sheuvin veshaav bechad veshafach letocho kol hayyom kullo kasher. velo od ella mikve elyon sheyyesh bo arbaim sea mayim kesherin vehaya memalle bichli venoten letocho ad sheyyirbu hammayim veyardu lammikve hattachton arbaim sea hare hattachton kasher: 
Mikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea mechuvvanot venatan letocho sea mayim sheuvin venatal achar kach mimmennu sea hare ze kasher. vechen noten sea venotel sea vehu kasher ad rubbo:

Mishneh Torah, Damages to Property 1: Kol nefesh chayya shehi birshuto shel adam shehizzika habbealim chayyavin leshallem shehare mamonam hizzik shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 la)</small> "chi yiggof shor ish et shor reehu". echad hashshor veechad shear behema chayya veof. lo dibber hakkatuv beshor ella bahove:

Habbehema muedet leechol perot o yerakot vechayyotze bahen. lefichach im nichnesa lirshut hannizzak veachla devarim sheddarkah leachlam meshallem nezek shalem shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 4)</small> "uvier bisde acher metav sadehu" vegomer. veim achalatam birshut harabbim patur. veim nehenet meshallem ma shennehenet lo ma shehizzika: 
Ketzad. nichnesa lirshut hannizzak veachla shumshemin o lot vechayyotze bahem bishve dinar meshallem dinar. veim achalatan birshut harabbim venehenet roin otan keillu hen seorim o amir umeshallem deme amir o deme seorim bezol: 
Achla ochalin haraim lah kegon sheachla chittin hoil velo nehenet patur. achla ochalin sheen darkah leachlan kegon sheachla kesut o kelim ben birshut hannizzak ben birshut harabbim meshallem chatzi nezek shezze shinnuy hu vederech bene adam lehanniach kelehem uchesutan birshut harabbim ad sheyyanuchu meat: 
Behema shehayta omedet birshut hannizzak vetalsha perot mershut harabbim vaachalatan birshut hannizzak hare haddavar safek lefichach enah meshallemet ella ma shennehenet. veim tafas hannizzak kamma shehizzika en motziin miyyado shehare birshuto achla: 
Kelev shennichnas lechatzer venatal pat o basar vehotzian lirshut harabbim o lechatzer acheret vaachalam ma shennehena meshallem. achalam bassade shel baal hechatzer meshallem nezek shalem keillu achalan betoch hechatzer shehare birshut hannizzak achal. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Behema sheachla ochalin sheen darkah leachlan aval ochaltan al yede haddechak. kegon para sheachla seorim vachamor sheachal karshinim o dagim vachazir sheachal chaticha basar vechelev shellikkek et hashshemen vechatul sheachal temarim. vechen kol kayyotze beellu. im achalah birshut hannizzak meshallem nezek shalem. uvirshut harabbim patur veim nehenet meshallem ma shennehenet: 
Chayya shennichnesa lirshut hannizzak vetarfa veachla behema o basar meshallem nezek shalem shezzehu darkah. aval kelev sheachal kevasim ketannim o chatul sheachal tarnegolim gedolim hare ze shinnuy umeshallem chatzi nezek: 
Sal sheyyesh bo lechem venichnas chamor veshavar hassal veachal hallechem meshallem al hassal veal hallechem nezek shalem shezze hu darko. vechen seir izzim sheraa lefet vechayyotze bo al pi hechavit venistabbech bechavit veachal et hallefet veshavar et hechavit meshallem al shenehem nezek shalem. keshem sheddarko leechol kach darko lehittalot bechelim velaalot kede leechol. vechen kol kayyotze baze. aval im nichnas hachamor veachal et hallechem veachar kach shavar et hassal al hallechem meshallem nezek shalem veal hassal chatzi nezek. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Behema sheachla mittoch harchava ben derech halichatah ben sheamda veachla meshallem ma shennehenet vaafillu chazra al tzidde harchava veachla mehen. aval im hinnicha et harchava vehalcha veamda betzidde harchava veachla meshallem ma shehizzika. achla mippetach hachanut meshallem ma shennehenet. mittoch hachanut meshallem ma shehizzika: 
Hayta mehallechet birshut harabbim ufashta tzavvarah veachla meal gabbe chavertah vaafillu amda meshallem ma shennehenet shekken derech habbehemot leechol zo meal gabbe zo. veim kaftza veachla al gabbe chavertah meshallem ma shehizzika sheggabbe chavertah kachatzar hannizzak hu chashuv: 
Behema shehuchleka beeven o bememe ragleha venafla leginna venechbeta al gabbe perot virakot o sheachla meshallem ma shennehenet. afillu halcha mearuga laaruga vaafillu nishara sham kol hayyom kullo eno meshallem ella ma shennehenet. uma hanaa yesh lah bachavita shehare matza makom rach velo nitrasseku evareha. aval im yarda kedarkah veachla meshallem ma shehizzika. vaafillu tinnefa perot beme leda meshallem ma shehizzika mippene shettechillato bifshia. vechen im dechafatah chavertah venafla meshallem ma shehizzika mippene shehaya lo lehaaviran achat achat kede shello yidchafu zo et zo: 
Huchleka venafla veyatzat vechazra lagginna af al pi shechazra shello ledaat habbealim meshallem ma shehizzika mippene shehaya lo leshamrah shello tachzor shehaddavar yadua shekkevan sheyyada derech hagginna hare hi chozeret meeleha: 
Hakkaddar shehichnis kederotav lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut ushevaratan behemto shel baal habbayit patur. veim huzzeka bahen baal hakkederot chayyav. veim hichnis birshut patur. veim kibbel alav baal habbayit lishmor et hakkederot baal habbayit chayyav: 
Vechen im hichnis perotav lachatzar baal habbayit shello birshut vaachalatam behemto shel baal habbayit patur. veim huchleka bahen vehuzzeka baal happerot chayyav. veim hichnis birshut patur. veim kibbel alav baal habbayit lishmor et happerot baal habbayit chayyav. hichnisan shello birshut vaachalatan behemto shel baal habbayit vehuzzeka baachilatan baal happerot patur mippene shehaya lah shello tochal. veim hichnisah birshut vehinnichu baale hechatzer et ze shehirshahu bechatzer leshamro vaachalatan behemto shel baal habbayit vehuzzeka baachilatan baal happerot chayyav. shekkevan sheraa habbehema ochelet devarim hammazzikin lah vehinnichah chayyav shehare en baale hechatzer metzuyin sham lehaavir habbehema mehen. umaase beishsha shennichnesa leefot battannur bevet shechenoteha vehinnichuha venitallemu kede shello yabbitu bah beet lishatah vaafiyyatah uva ez shel baal habbayit veachal habbatzek umet vechiyyevuha chachamim leshallem damav. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hammagdish betoch sede chavero shello birshut vaachalatan behemto shel baal hassade patur. veim huchleka bahen vehuzzeka baal happerot chayyav. achalatan vehuzzeka baachilatan patur. veim higgedish birshut baal hassade chayyav af al pi shello kibbel alav lishmor. shehashshomer bogoranot kevan sheamar lo hagedesh bechan kemi sheamar lo hagedesh vaani eshmor lecha hu chashuv:
Mishneh Torah, Damages to Property 4:
Hakkonnes tzon laddir venaal bifnehen bedelet sheyyechola laamod beruach metzuya veyatza vehizzika patur. veim enah yechola laamod beruach metzuya o shehayu katle haddir reuin hare lo naal bifnehen karauy veim yatzat vehizzika chayyav. vaafillu chatra veyatzat vaafillu nifretza mechitztza ballayla o peratzuha listim baal hatztzon chayyav. hayta mechitztza beria venifretza ballayla o shepperatzuha listim veyatzat vehizzika patur. hotziuha listim vehizzika listim chayyavim: 
Happoretz gader lifne behemat chavero veyatzat vehizzika. im haya gader chazak uvari chayyav. veim haya kotel raua patur bedine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim. vechen hannoten sam hammavet lifne behemat chavero patur middine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim: 
Hammaamid behemat chavero al gabbe kamat chavero hammaamid chayyav leshallem ma shehizzik. vechen im hikkishah ad shehalcha lekamat chavero vehizzika ze shehikkishah chayyav: 
Hammoser behemto leshomer chinnam o lenose sachar o lesocher o leshoel nichnesu tachat habbealim veim hizzika chayyav hashshomer. bamme devarim amurim bizman shello shemaruha kelal. aval im shemaruha shemira meulla karauy veyatzat vehizzika hashshomrim peturin vehabbealim chayyavim afillu hemita et haadam. shemaruha shemira pechuta im shomer chinnam hu patur veim shomer sachar o socher o shoel hu chayyavin: 
Hinnichah bachamma afillu chatra veyatzat vehizzika chayyav ze shehinnichah sham. shekkevan shehinnichah bachamma hare hi mitztaeret uvorachat veosa kol sheefshar lah laasot: 
Masar behemto lecheresh shote vekatan af al pi shehaya hashshor kashur habbealim chayyavin. shedderech hashshor vechayyotze bo lehattir hakkesher velatzet ulehazzik. afillu shemaruha shemira meulla vechatra veyatza vehizzika habbealim chayyavim: 
Masar shoro lachamishsha ufasha bo echad mehen veyatza vehizzik im eno mishtammer ella bachamishshetan ze sheppasha bishmirato chayyav. veim mishtammer bisheran af ellu hannisharin chayyavin: 
Shealo bechezkat tam venimtza muad. im yada hashshoel shehu nagchan habbealim meshallemim chatzi nezek shekkol makom shehu holech hare shem bealav alav. vehashshoel meshallem chatzi nezek. sheafillu haya tam (kesheala bedato) chatzi nezek haya meshallem shehare yada shehu nagchan. veim lo yada shehu nagchan en hashshoel chayyav kelum vehabbealim meshallemin nezek shalem: 
Shealo keshehu tam vehuad bevet hashshoel vehecheziro livalav chazar letammuto. hoil venishtannet reshuto batla hahaada vehabbealim meshallemin chatzi nezek vehashshoel patur shehare hecheziro: 
Shomer shekkibbel alav shemirat guf habbehema bilvad aval lo shemirat nezakeha vehizzika patur milleshallem vehabbealim chayyavim. kibbel shemirat nezakeha vehizzika chayyav hashshomer. veim huzzeka patur vehabbealim osim din im hammazzik: 
Masar hashshomer leshomer acher hashshomer harishon chayyav leshallem lannizzak shehashshomer shemmasar leshomer chayyav. vahare hannizzak omer lo lamma lo shamarta atta beatzmecha umasarta leacher shalem li atta velech vaase din im hashshomer shemmasarta lo atta. mesarah hashshomer livno o leven beto o limsaado nichnesu tachat hashshomer vechayyavim: 
Kol shomer shennitchayyev leshallem veen lo vehaya hammazzik tam shehu meshallem chatzi nezek miggufo hare hannizzak mishtallem min habbehema shehizzika veyishshaer deme ma sheggava hannizzak chov al hashshomer levaal habbehema: 
Kol behema shehizzika perot mechubbarin meshaarin ma shehizzika beshishshim umeshallem ze shennitchayyev leshallem ben habbealim ben hashshomrim. ketzad. hare sheachla bet sea shamin shishshim bet sea beotah hassade kamma haya shave vechamma hu shave atta achar shennifsad bo habbet sea umeshallem hashshear. vechen im achla kav o rova afillu kelach echad shamin oto beshishshim: 
Achla perot gemurin sheen tzerichim lakkarka meshallem deme perot gemurin bishvehen im sea deme sea veim satayim deme satayim. hare sheachla perot dekel echad vechen halloket perot dekel chavero veachal im haya dekel romi vechayyotze bo sheen hattemarim shello yafot meshaarin oto beshishshim al gav hakkarka. veim dekel parsi vechayyotze bo hu shehattemarim shello yafot beyoter meshaarin haddekel bifne atzmo kamma haya shave vechamma hu shave atta:
Mishneh Torah, Damages to Property 5:
Behema shehayta roa ufarsha venichnesa bassadot uvakkeramim af al pi sheadayin lo hizzika matrin bivaleha shalosh peamim. im lo shamar behemto velo menaah millirot yesh reshut levaal hassade leshochotah shechita keshera veomer livaleha bou umichru basar shellachem. mippene sheasur laadam lehazzik uleshallem ma shehizzik afillu ligrom hannezek asur: 
Lefichach asru chachamim legaddel behema dakka vechayya dakka beeretz yisrael bimkom hassadot vehakkeramim ella bayarim uvammidbarot shebbeeretz yisrael. umegaddelin besureya bechol makom: 
Asara tenaim hitna yehoshua uvet dino beshaa shechillek et haaretz veellu hen. 1) hitna shemmarin behema dakka biarim sheilanehen gassin. aval en marin sham behema gassa. uveyaar sheilanav dakkim en marin bo lo gassa velo dakka ella middaat bealav. 2) vechen hitna sheyyihye kol adam muttar lelakket etzim missede chavero. vehu sheyyihyu etzim pechutim ukerovim lihyot kotzim kegon hizme vehige. vehu sheyyihyu lachim umechubbarin uvilvad shello yesharesh. aval shear etzim asur. 3) vechen hitna sheyyihye kol adam muttar lelakket asavim haolin mealehen bechol makom chutz missede tiltan shezzeraah livhema. 4) vechen hitna sheyyihye adam kotem netia bechol makom chutz miggerofiyyot shel zayit veeno kotem min hailanot ella bezayit kevetza uvekanim uvigfanim min happekak ulemala uvishar hailan mittocho shel ilan lo mechuddo. ucheshehittir liktom lo hittir ella mechadash sheeno ose perot aval lo miyyashan sheose perot. veeno kotem ella mimmakom sheeno roe pene chamma. 5) vechen hitna shehammayan hayyotze battechilla bene otah hair sheyyatza bigvulam mistappekin mimmennu af al pi sheen ikkaro bechelkam. veen laacherim lehistappek immahem mimmennu. 6) vechen hitna sheyyihye kol adam muttar latzud dagim miyyam teverya vehu sheyyatzud bechakka bilvad. aval lo yifrosho kela veyaamid sefina sham ella bene hashshevet shehiggia oto hayyam bechelkam. 7) vechen hitna shekkol adam shetztzarich linkavav mistallek min hadderech venichnas achore haggader sheppaga bo venifne sham vaafillu besade melea karkom venotel mishsham tzeror umekanneach. 8) vechen hitna shekkol hattoe ben hakkeramim vechayyotze bahen mefasseg veole mefasseg veyored ad sheyyetze ledarko. 9) vechen hitna shebbizman sheyyirbe hattit bedarche harabbim o nekie mayim yesh leovre derachim lehistallek letzidde hadderachim umehallechin sham af al pi shehen mehallechin bederech sheyyesh lah bealim. 10) vechen hitna shemmet mitzva kone mekomo venikbar bammakom sheyyimmatze bo. shello yihye muttal al hammetzar velo betoch techum hammedina. aval im nimtza al hammetzar o shehaya betoch hattechum mevio levet hakkevarot: 
Shelomo tikken sheyyihyu ovre derachim muttarin bimot hachamma lehallech bashshevilin shebbassadot sheyyesh lahen bealim ad shettered revia sheniyya: 
Vetakkanot ellu kullan nohagot bechol makom afillu bechutza laaretz: 
Umishsheyyarad hattal bevavel asur lehallech bishvilin sheyyesh lahen bealim: 
Af al pi sheen megaddelin behema dakka beeretz yisrael muttar lashhotah kodem laregel sheloshim yom vekodem lemishte beno sheloshim yom. vehattabbach lokeach veshochet lokeach umashhe ad sheyyishchot meat meat. uvilvad shello tetze vetire baeder. ella kol hammashhe mashhe betoch beto kede shello tazzik: 
Uchevar asu bavel keeretz yisrael leesor bah giddul behema dakka vechayya dakka mippene shehayu rov hassadot vehakkeramim sham beotan hayyamim shel yisrael: 
Vechen asru chachamim legaddel chazirim bechol makom. velo et hakkelev ella im ken haya kashur beshalshelet. aval megaddel hu kelavim bair hassemucha lassefar. bayyom koshro uvallayla mattiro. veamru chachamim arur megaddel kelavim vachazirim mippene shehezzekan merubbe umatzuy:

Mishneh Torah, Damages to Property 6:
Ezehu muad kol sheheidu bo shelosha yamim. aval im nagach beyom echad o nashach o ravatz o baat o nagaf afillu mea peamim en ze muad. heidu bo shelosha kitte edim beyom echad hare ze safek im huad o lo huad: 
En heada ella bifne habbealim uvifne bet din shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 29)</small> "vehuad bivalav". veen heada ella bevet din: 
Shor shel cheresh shote vekatan umi shehu bimdinat hayyam shennagchu peturin. aval bet din maamidin lahem appotroppesin umeidin bahen bifne haappotroppesin: 
Hizziku achar shehuadu bifne appotroppesin im adayin hu tam meshallem chatzi nezek miggufo veim huad bo shelosha yamim veachar kach hizzik meshallem nezek shalem min hayyafe shebbenichse appotroppesin. velichsheyyigdelu hayetomim yaasu din im haappotroppesin vishallemu lahen: 
Shevarim shemmesachakin bahen umelammedin otan liggach ze et ze enam muadim ze laze. vaafillu hemitu et haadam enan chayyavin mita shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 28)</small> "chi yiggach" lo sheyyaggichuhu: 
Shor shehuad venimkar o nittan bemattana chazar letammuto sheharshut shennishtannet meshanna dino. aval im hishilo o mesaro leshomer hare hu bechezkato. vechen shor shehuad bifne appotroppesin venitpakkeach hacheresh venishtappa hashshota vehigdil hakkatan af al pi shebbatlu haappotroppesin hare hen muadin bechezkatan shehare birshut bealim hen: 
Behema shehuada vechazra bah middavar shehuada lo chazra letammutah. ketzad. shor shehuad liggach vechazar shello liggach af al pi shehu nogef hare ze tam lingicha. umeematay hu chazarato ad sheyyihyu hattinokot memashmeshin bo veeno nogeach. vechen bishar haddevarim shehuad lahen ad sheyyemashmeshu bo velo yihye ose otan: 
Shor shehu muad lemino hare ze eno muad lesheeno mino. huad leadam eno moed livhema. huad liktannim eno muad ligdolim. lefichach im hizzik et min shehu muad lo meshallem nezek shalem veim hizzik lishar hamminin meshallem chatzi nezek. haya muad leshabbatot eno muad limot hachol veim hizzik beshabbatot meshallem nezek shalem uvimot hachol meshallem chatzi nezek. umeematay hi chazarato mishsheyyemashmeshu hattinokot bo bayyom shehu muad lo velo yihye mazzik nezek shehuad lo: 
Nagach shor hayyom vachamor lemachar vegamal beyom shelishi naasa muad lakkol. raa shor hayyom unegacho. ulemachar raa shor velo negacho. uvayyom hashshelishi raa shor unegacho. uvarvii raa shor velo negacho. uvachamishi raa shor unegacho. uvashshishshi raa shor velo negacho. naasa muad leserugin lishvarim. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Mishneh Torah, Damages to Property 7:
Shor shekkesharo bealav bemosera venaal befanav karauy veyatza vehizzik. im tam hu meshallem chatzi nezek. veim haya muad patur shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 36)</small> "velo yishmerennu" ha im shemaro patur veshamur hu ze. vechen im hizzik bedavar shehu muad lo mittechillato kegon sheachal devarim haruyim lo o shavar beraglav bederech hillucho patur milleshallem: 
Haya muad lekeren yamin veeno muad lekeren semol veyatza achar sheshshemaro karauy venagach ben bekeren yamin ben bismol meshallem chatzi nezek:

Ketzad. shor shave matayim shennegachuhu umet vahare hannevela shava bishat mita mea uvishat haamada baddin pachata vahare shava shemonim. en hammazzik meshallem ella mea im haya muad. veim haya tam meshallem lo chamishshim miggufo: 
Hishbicha hannevela vahare hi shava bishat haamada baddin mea veesrim. hare hammazzik meshallem lo tishim im haya muad. veim haya tam meshallem arbaim vachamishsha miggufo vezehu shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 la)</small> "vegam et hammet yechetzun" [shevach hammet yechetzun]: 
Shor shave matayim shennagach shor shave matayim vehifchito chamishshim uvishat haamada baddin hishbiach hannizzak vahare hu shave arba meot zuz veillule hannegicha shehifchito haya shave shemone meot. ben sheppittemo ben sheshshibbeach meelav en noten ella kishat hannezek. kichesh mechamat hammakka bishat haamada baddin vahare happechat shave mea noten lo kishat haamada baddin: 
Hishbiach hammazzik bishat haamada baddin. im mechamat sheppittemo shibbeach eno mishtallem mimmennu ella ma shehaya shave beshaa shehizzik. veim mechamat atzmo hishbiach mishtallem chatzi nezek mimmennu kullo kishat haamada baddin: 
Al hammazzik litroach bannevela ad shemmamtzi otah lannizzak. ketzad. kegon shennafal hashshor labbor umet maale hannevela min habbor venotnah lannizzak veachar kach shamin lo pechat nevela shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 34)</small> "kesef yashiv livalav vehammet yihye lo". melammed shehu chayyav lehashiv et hannevela veet happechat sheppachata min hachay lannizzak. veim haya tam chatzi happechat. kemo shebbearnu:
